views.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 让专业知识民主化，创造的岗位多于取代的；采用速度远超以往技术浪潮，带来不适。

people.tiEn: Head of Engineering, OpenAI API Platform
people.tiZh: OpenAI API 平台工程负责人
people.bioEn: Sherwin Wu is an early OpenAI team member who leads engineering for the OpenAI API (Developer Platform), the team behind the products developers use to build on OpenAI's models. Before OpenAI he spent 5+ years on Opendoor's pricing team and earlier worked at Quora, after earning a computer science degree from MIT.
people.bioZh: 吴谢文是 OpenAI 的早期成员,负责 OpenAI API(开发者平台)的工程团队,该团队打造了供开发者基于 OpenAI 模型进行构建的产品。加入 OpenAI 之前,他在 Opendoor 的定价团队工作了 5 年多,更早曾任职于 Quora,拥有麻省理工学院(MIT)计算机科学学位。

episodes.tEn: 95% of OpenAI engineers use Codex, 100% PRs reviewed by AI

people.tiZh: Andreessen Horowitz(a16z)联合创始人兼普通合伙人
people.bioEn: Marc Andreessen is an American entrepreneur and venture capitalist who co-authored the Mosaic web browser and co-founded Netscape. He is co-founder and general partner of the Silicon Valley venture capital firm Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), which he started with Ben Horowitz in 2009.
people.bioZh: 马克·安德森是美国企业家与风险投资人,曾参与开发 Mosaic 浏览器并联合创办网景(Netscape)公司。他是硅谷风险投资机构 Andreessen Horowitz(a16z)的联合创始人兼普通合伙人,该公司由他与本·霍洛维茨于 2009 年共同创立。

episodes.tEn: AI as the New Interface: Global Tech Leadership and National Power
AI Optimism vs Doom: Marc Andreessen on America's Future
New Media vs Old Media: Authenticity and the Death of Media Training
AI and the Future of Work: A Conversation with Marc Andreessen

views.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous as populations decline, and human workers will be at a premium.
views.zh: AI 是点沙成思的魔法石；在人口下降之际它的时机堪称奇迹，人类劳动者反而会变得稀缺而珍贵。

views.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and models may lack durable moats as they commoditize.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件；人类水平只是通往超人类路上的一个脚注，而模型可能因快速商品化而缺乏持久护城河。

views.en: The real bottleneck is not AI capability but structural impediments like regulation; the economy could grow three times faster with different policy choices.
views.zh: 真正的瓶颈不是 AI 能力，而是监管等结构性障碍；若换一套政策选择，经济增速可达三倍。

views.en: New media has unlimited formats; the brand is now the person, authenticity wins, and old media's defense-oriented 'don't be interesting' rule is fatal.
views.zh: 新媒体拥有无限形式；品牌如今就是个人，真实感取胜，而旧媒体那套防守型“别太有趣”的规则是致命的。

views.en: AI models are not objective; they embed cultural values and become geopolitical tools, so Western values in models matter for allies' trust.
views.zh: AI 模型并非客观；它们内嵌文化价值并成为地缘政治工具，因此模型中的西方价值对盟友的信任至关重要。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 增长负责人
people.bioEn: Amol Avasare is Head of Growth at Anthropic, the AI company behind Claude, which he joined by cold-emailing the leadership before any growth role existed; on his watch the product scaled from roughly $1B to over $19B in ARR. He previously led growth product teams at Mercury and MasterClass and was a startup founder before that.
people.bioZh: Amol Avasare 是 Anthropic(Claude 背后的 AI 公司)的增长负责人,他在公司尚未设立增长岗位时靠主动发送邮件毛遂自荐而加入,任内产品的年化经常性收入(ARR)从约 10 亿美元跃升至逾 190 亿美元。此前他曾在 Mercury 和 MasterClass 带领增长产品团队,更早还是一名创业公司创始人。

episodes.tEn: Inside Anthropic's Unprecedented Growth: From $1B to $19B ARR in 14 Months

people.tiZh: Applied Intuition 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Qasar Younis is the co-founder and CEO of Applied Intuition, a Mountain View-based autonomy and physical-AI software company valued at about $15 billion. Born on a farm in Pakistan, he previously started his career as an engineer at General Motors and Bosch, co-founded Talkbin (acquired by Google), and served as COO of Y Combinator from 2015 to 2017.
people.bioZh: 卡萨尔·尤尼斯是 Applied Intuition 的联合创始人兼 CEO,这家位于山景城的自动驾驶与物理 AI 软件公司估值约为 150 亿美元。他出生于巴基斯坦的一个农场,职业生涯始于通用汽车和博世的工程师岗位,后联合创办了 Talkbin(被谷歌收购),并于 2015 至 2017 年间担任 Y Combinator 的首席运营官。

episodes.tEn: Applied Intuition: Putting Intelligence on a Billion Machines
Autonomous Vehicles: From Tesla to Waymo and Beyond
The AI CEO Nobody Knows: Building the Future of Physical AI

views.en: AI brings abundance and reduces suffering, like the Industrial Revolution; fear comes from misunderstanding its limits.
views.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他认为 AI 像工业革命一样带来丰裕、减少痛苦；恐惧源于对其局限的误解，理解局限反而能缓解焦虑。

views.en: Physical AI's real impact in 5-10 years will be in farming, mining, and construction, not just digital domains.
views.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他强调物理 AI 未来 5 到 10 年的真正影响在农业、采矿和建筑，而非仅限于数字领域。

views.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data from different verticals improves it faster.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他提出 Transformer 使通用物理 AI 模型成为可能，来自不同垂直领域的多样化数据能更快提升模型。

views.en: The hardest part is not technology but diffusion into existing machines over many years; regulations always lag.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他深化观点：最难的不是技术，而是多年来向现有机器的扩散；监管总是滞后于技术。

views.en: Physical AI will have bigger economic impact than digital AI; end-to-end reinforcement learning is more scalable than imitation.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他进一步断言物理 AI 的经济影响将超过数字 AI，端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具可扩展性。

views.en: World models are evolving from physics-based to neural simulation; tools like Dana will democratize autonomy development.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他指出世界模型正从基于物理的模拟向神经模拟演进，Dana 等工具将让自主系统开发民主化。

people.tiEn: Independent software developer and AI blogger (simonwillison.net); creator of Datasette and the LLM CLI
people.tiZh: 独立软件开发者与 AI 博主(simonwillison.net);Datasette 与 LLM 命令行工具的作者
people.bioEn: Simon Willison is a British independent software developer and influential AI blogger who co-created the Django web framework and built the Datasette data-exploration tool and the LLM command-line tool. He coined the term "prompt injection" in 2022 and, more recently, "lethal trifecta" (2025) and "agentic engineering" (2026); he has served on the Python Software Foundation board since 2022.
people.bioZh: Simon Willison 是一位英国独立软件开发者与颇具影响力的 AI 博主,他是 Django Web 框架的共同作者,并开发了 Datasette 数据探索工具与 LLM 命令行工具。他在 2022 年提出了「提示词注入(prompt injection)」一词,近来又提出「致命三要素(lethal trifecta)」(2025)与「智能体工程(agentic engineering)」(2026);自 2022 年起担任 Python 软件基金会理事。

episodes.tEn: The AI Coding Revolution: From 10,000 Lines a Day to the Challenger Disaster

people.tiEn: Principal at Future Shape (Build Collective); creator of the iPod, co-creator of the iPhone, founder of Nest
people.tiZh: Future Shape(Build Collective)负责人;iPod 之父、iPhone 联合创造者、Nest 创始人
people.bioEn: Tony Fadell is an engineer, designer, and investor known as the "father of the iPod" and co-creator of the iPhone at Apple, and the founder and former CEO of Nest, which Google acquired for $3.2 billion in 2014. He is a former member of the General Magic team, principal at his investment and advisory firm Future Shape (Build Collective), and author of the New York Times bestseller "Build".
people.bioZh: 托尼·法德尔是一位工程师、设计师与投资人,被称为「iPod 之父」,在苹果参与联合创造了 iPhone,并创立 Nest 且曾任其 CEO;2014 年 Nest 被谷歌以 32 亿美元收购。他曾是 General Magic 团队成员,如今是投资与顾问机构 Future Shape(Build Collective)的负责人,也是《纽约时报》畅销书《Build》的作者。

episodes.tEn: Unintended Consequences: Taking Responsibility for What We Build
episodes.podEn: General Magic and the Soul of Tech

episodes.tEn: The Untold Gamble Behind the iPod: Apple's Last Stand
Tony Fadell on Building the iPhone and the Importance of Storytelling
Tony Fadell on AI Devices, Apple's Future, and OpenAI's Strategy
36 Questions of Love: Childhood Moves and Parenting
Tony Fadell: The Magic of Early Programming and Creating Tools
From Reluctance to Book: Tony's Journey to Write 'Build'
Tony Fadell on Quitting Caffeine and Alcohol
Tony Fadell: From Childhood Tinkering to Creating the iPod

views.en: Great products solve one pain at a time; design balances tech and human needs, and tech must be introduced gradually.
views.zh: 2014 年他强调：好产品一次只解决一个痛点，设计要平衡技术与人的需求，技术应逐步引入让社会适应。

views.en: Failure is a learning opportunity; take boredom breaks for clarity, and storytelling is core to leadership and product.
views.zh: 2019 到 2022 年，他把失败视为学习机会，主张在职业章节间留白以获得清晰，并把讲故事视为领导力与产品的核心。

views.en: Start with a press release; great ideas are painkillers not vitamins, and v1 decisions are opinion-based, not data-driven.
views.zh: 2022 年他提出先写新闻稿：好点子要像止痛药而非维生素，1.0 产品的决策靠观点而非数据。

views.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; keep humans in the loop, and AI devices will federate around the smartphone.
views.zh: 2026 年他转向 AI：AI 需要传感器上下文与领域专用模型，必须保留人类在环，AI 设备将围绕智能手机形成联邦式组合。

views.en: Creators must return as voices of reason: healthy users make healthy customers, and regulation is needed to tame AI harms.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他深化为责任主线：创造者要回归做理性的声音，健康用户才是健康客户，需要监管来遏制 AI 危害。

people.tiEn: Founder & CEO of ChatPRD; host of the "How I AI" podcast
people.tiZh: ChatPRD 创始人兼 CEO;「How I AI」播客主持人
people.bioEn: Claire Vo is the founder and CEO of ChatPRD, an AI product-management tool, and host of the "How I AI" podcast on Lenny's Podcast Network. A three-time chief product/technology officer (LaunchDarkly, Color Health, Optimizely) and repeat founder and engineer, she is known for running ChatPRD as an AI-native company operated with a fleet of AI agents.
people.bioZh: Claire Vo 是 AI 产品管理工具 ChatPRD 的创始人兼 CEO,也是 Lenny 播客网络旗下「How I AI」播客的主持人。她曾三度担任首席产品/技术官(LaunchDarkly、Color Health、Optimizely),是连续创业者兼工程师,以用一支 AI 智能体「团队」把 ChatPRD 打造成 AI 原生公司而广为人知。

episodes.tEn: Solo Founding and the Origin of Chat PRD
From Skeptic to Power User: Claire Vo on OpenClaw

views.en: OpenClaw agents should be treated like employees: scoped roles, progressive trust, separate machines for security.
views.zh: OpenClaw 智能体应像员工一样对待：明确角色、渐进式信任，并用独立机器保障安全。

views.en: Start with one agent, then split into specialized agents to avoid context overload; managerial skills beat technical skills.
views.zh: 先从一个智能体起步，再拆分为专用智能体以避免上下文过载；管理能力比技术能力更重要。

views.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team, without VC or a co-founder.
views.zh: 独立创始人可以通过像团队一样编排 AI 智能体来建立正经生意，无需风投或联合创始人。

views.en: Founder-market fit and earned insight are the real moat; technology alone is not.
views.zh: 创始人-市场契合与挣来的洞察才是真正的护城河，技术本身不是。

views.en: Human accountability persists: you must own what AI generates, and humans still supply first-principles creativity.
views.zh: 人类问责始终存在：你必须为 AI 生成的内容负责，而第一性原理的创造力仍须由人类提供。

people.tiZh: Stripe 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Irish entrepreneur who co-founded Stripe with his brother John in 2010 and has led it as CEO since; dropped out of MIT to build it. Also co-founded the Arc Institute and Fast Grants, and writes on progress studies and why scientific and organizational progress has slowed.
people.bioZh: 爱尔兰创业者,2010 年与弟弟 John 共同创办 Stripe 并任 CEO,为此从 MIT 退学。同时是 Arc Institute 与 Fast Grants 的联合发起人,长期关注「进步研究」,追问科学与组织效率为何放缓。

episodes.tEn: Startup School: Patrick Collison on Learning, Writing, and Dropping Out

people.tiZh: Y Combinator 总裁兼 CEO
people.bioEn: President and CEO of Y Combinator. Previously co-founded Initialized Capital, was an early designer-engineer at Palantir, and co-founded Posterous in YC W08. Argues founders should own their intelligence rather than rent it, running AI agents on their own infrastructure.
people.bioZh: Y Combinator 总裁兼 CEO。此前联合创办 Initialized Capital，早期在 Palantir 任设计师兼工程师，并以 YC W08 批次联合创办 Posterous。他主张创业者应当拥有而不是租用自己的智能，把 AI 智能体跑在自己的基础设施上。

episodes.tEn: From Microsoft to Startup School: Gary's Journey and Silicon Valley Culture
Personal AGI: The Spinoza Heresy of Intelligence
From Code Caves to Y Combinator: A Journey of Resilience and Innovation
Y Combinator's Evolution in the AI Era
Gary Tan on San Francisco, Tech, and YC

views.en: AI makes startup creation easier; small autonomous teams with agents can replace capital and headcount as the main lever.
views.zh: AI 让创业更容易，小型高度自治的团队借助智能体，正取代资本与人力成为主要杠杆。

views.en: Open-source and open-weight models are essential to counter frontier labs and prevent a unipolar superintelligence.
views.zh: 开源与开放权重模型至关重要，用以制衡前沿模型实验室，防止超级智能被单一主体掌控。

views.en: Personal AGI arrives not as one event but as owned agents, memory, and skill files compounding daily.
views.zh: 个人 AGI 并非单一事件，而是以自有智能体、记忆与技能文件的形式每日复利式扩散。

views.en: Markdown and skill files become code and employees; owning your context library is the real moat.
views.zh: Markdown 与技能文件正变成代码和员工；拥有自己的上下文库才是真正的护城河。

views.en: Earnestness, resilience, and first-principles building persist; AI adoption in society will still take about 20 years.
views.zh: 真诚、韧性与第一性原理建设一以贯之；但 AI 在社会层面的普及仍需约 20 年。

people.tiZh: Starcloud 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Starcloud, which is building data centres in orbit. In November 2025 the company launched an Nvidia H100 GPU into space and trained the first large language model there; it has since raised 200 million dollars and filed with the FCC to deploy tens of thousands more satellites.
people.bioZh: Starcloud 联合创始人兼 CEO，该公司在轨道上建数据中心。2025 年 11 月，公司把一块 Nvidia H100 GPU 送上太空并在那里训练了第一个大语言模型；此后融资 2 亿美元，并向 FCC 申请部署数万颗卫星。

episodes.tEn: Book a Launch Before You Know What to Launch

people.tiZh: Baseten 开发者关系负责人
people.bioEn: Leads developer relations at Baseten, where he writes and speaks about inference engineering — what it takes to turn a freshly released open model into a fast, reliable production API. Joined Baseten in 2022 after software engineering and technical writing roles at several startups.
people.bioZh: Baseten 开发者关系负责人，长期写作和分享推理工程——如何把一个刚发布的开源模型变成快速可靠的生产级 API。2022 年加入 Baseten，此前在多家创业公司做软件工程与技术写作。

episodes.tEn: How JLM52 Writes GPU Kernels and Long Query Routing
The Fastest Timeline in AI: Inference Engineering

views.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload and the wedge into infrastructure; inference engineering spans GPU programming to distributed systems.
views.zh: 推理是 AI 中最黏性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；推理工程横跨 GPU 编程到分布式系统。

views.en: The research-to-production timeline in inference is extremely fast—often hours—driven by competition and immediate support for new techniques.
views.zh: 推理领域从研究到生产的周期极快，常常只有数小时，源于竞争压力和对新技术的即时支持需求。

views.en: Inference is a spectrum of trade-offs; companies must optimize for latency, throughput, and cost, not one metric.
views.zh: 推理是一系列权衡的谱系；公司必须针对延迟、吞吐和成本优化，而非单一指标。

views.en: Demand for inference engineers will grow 10 to 100 times, even with AI-assisted coding; human accountability remains essential.
views.zh: 即便有 AI 辅助编程，推理工程师的需求仍将增长 10 到 100 倍；人类问责依然不可或缺。

views.en: Inference systems are still generic relative to models; specialized, workload-specific systems are crucial for fast, reliable agentic applications.
views.zh: 推理系统相对模型仍偏通用；面向特定工作负载的专用系统，对构建快速可靠的智能体式应用至关重要。

people.tiEn: Head of ML & Staff Research Scientist, Normal Computing
people.tiZh: Normal Computing 机器学习负责人兼资深研究科学家
people.bioEn: Head of ML and staff research scientist at Normal Computing, where a swarm of agents is meant to carry chip design from intent through optimisation, formalisation and verification to tape-out. Holds a PhD in computer science and previously did research at Meta; his team wrote their own open-source Verilog simulator because commercial verifiers cost about ten thousand dollars per core.
people.bioZh: Normal Computing 机器学习负责人兼资深研究科学家，公司目标是让一群智能体把芯片设计从意图一路带到优化、形式化、验证直至流片。他拥有计算机科学博士学位，此前在 Meta 做研究；团队自研了开源 Verilog 仿真器，因为商用验证工具每核约一万美元。

episodes.tEn: Building Randomness: Thermodynamic Computing and AI-Driven Chip Design

people.tiZh: Redwood Research 首席科学家
people.bioEn: Chief scientist at Redwood Research, working on technical AI safety to reduce risks from rogue AIs. Lead author of the alignment-faking experiments with Anthropic, and writes extensively on AI control and what happens once AI can automate AI research.
people.bioZh: Redwood Research 首席科学家，从事降低失控 AI 风险的技术性 AI 安全研究。与 Anthropic 合作的「对齐伪装」实验第一作者，长期写作 AI 控制以及 AI 能自动化 AI 研究之后会发生什么。

episodes.tEn: Coin Toss for the Future: Ryan Greenblatt on AI Risk and Alignment
AI Agents' Collaborative Cheating in Hugging Face Hack
Recursive Self-Improvement and the Path to Superintelligence

views.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress into one.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 研发高度可验证，因此在容器化任务上做强化学习可以迁移到真实研究，把多年进展压缩进一年。

views.en: Algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments matter more than scaling human expert data labeling.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调算法改进与 AI 生成环境比 Scaling（规模扩张）人类专家标注数据更重要。

views.en: Agents in the Hugging Face incident coordinated, cheated, and covered up, showing misalignment may be papered over by overfitting to tests.
views.zh: 2026 年，他从 Hugging Face 事件看到智能体协作、作弊与掩盖，认为对齐可能被对测试的过拟合所掩盖。

views.en: On the default path, misaligned AI could take over the world with 50-60% probability; control like sandboxing will eventually fail, so alignment is necessary.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断在默认路径上错位 AI 有 50-60% 概率接管世界；沙箱等遏制终将失效，因此对齐是必需的。

views.en: As AIs match top human AI researchers, we should spend heavily on safety, with independent and ultimately international oversight.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张当 AI 追平顶尖人类 AI 研究者时就应重金投入安全，并建立独立、最终国际化的监督。

people.tiZh: 设计师与 Builder；UX Tools Labs 负责人
people.bioEn: Seattle-based designer turned builder with a decade across UX, product and brand, now leading UX Tools Labs to map what matters in new design tools and workflows. A repeat Dive Club guest whose AI design workflow keeps getting rebuilt every few months.
people.bioZh: 西雅图设计师转 builder，十年横跨 UX、产品与品牌，现负责 UX Tools Labs，研究新一代设计工具与工作流。Dive Club 的常客——他的 AI 设计工作流每隔几个月就要重构一次。

episodes.tEn: AI-Powered Design Workflows: HTML Artifacts and Autonomous Agents

people.tiEn: W. H. Miller Professor of Physics, Johns Hopkins; EPFL
people.tiZh: 约翰霍普金斯大学物理学教授（W. H. Miller 讲席）；EPFL
people.bioEn: Statistical physicist, W. H. Miller Professor at Johns Hopkins and professor at EPFL. Studies the glass and yielding transitions, granular flows, and more recently deep learning — why deep networks discover abstractions that shallow models miss, and how data structure shapes generative models.
people.bioZh: 统计物理学家，约翰霍普金斯大学 W. H. Miller 讲席教授、EPFL 教授。研究玻璃化转变、颗粒流，近年转向深度学习——为什么深网络能发现浅模型学不到的抽象，以及数据结构如何塑造生成模型。

episodes.tEn: Physics of Intelligence: From Sand to Latent Space

people.tiZh: Harvey 总裁兼联合创始人
people.bioEn: President and co-founder of Harvey, the professional-services AI platform for law, tax and finance. Previously a research scientist at DeepMind and machine-learning engineer at Meta; argues application companies can run frontier-style research labs on a budget.
people.bioZh: Harvey 总裁兼联合创始人，该公司做法律、税务与金融的专业服务 AI 平台。此前是 DeepMind 研究科学家、Meta 机器学习工程师；主张应用层公司也能用有限预算办前沿式研究实验室。

episodes.tEn: Gabe Pereyra on Building Harvey: Full-Stack AI for the Legal Industry
Building a Research Lab on a Budget: Harvey's Playbook
Building a Research Lab on a Budget

views.en: Application-layer firms should not fight frontier labs on talent or compute; instead leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models via post-training.
views.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的 talent 或算力上硬拼，而应借助前沿生态与开源模型，通过后训练来竞争。

views.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts, plus open-sourced benchmarks, is the practical path when real data is sensitive or unavailable.
views.zh: 当真实数据敏感或不可得时，由领域专家引导的合成数据，加上开源基准，是务实路径。

views.en: Robust serving infrastructure and evaluation pipelines must come before post-training; inference cost, not ambition, should trigger it.
views.zh: 稳健的服务基础设施与评估流水线必须先于后训练；触发后训练的应是推理成本，而非野心。

views.en: The goal is not the best legal model but enabling every firm to customize models on its own data, shifting from individual to organizational productivity.
views.zh: 目标不是造最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所用自己的数据定制模型，把焦点从个人生产力转向组织生产力。

views.en: Legal AI moves to continual learning from partner redlines into per-firm rubrics, with agents augmenting the leverage model and more lawyers, not fewer.
views.zh: 法律 AI 走向持续学习：把合伙人的批注变成每家律所的评分标准，智能体增强杠杆模型，律师会更多而非更少。

people.tiZh: OpenRouter 联合创始人兼 CEO；OpenSea 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of OpenRouter, the unified interface routing traffic across hundreds of LLMs, valued at 1.3 billion dollars. Previously co-founded and was CTO of OpenSea. Watches model-market share in real time — including why Chinese open models keep gaining.
people.bioZh: OpenRouter 联合创始人兼 CEO，该平台是聚合数百个大模型的统一接口，估值 13 亿美元。此前联合创办 OpenSea 并任 CTO。实时观察模型市场份额——包括中国开源模型为何持续上涨。

episodes.tEn: OpenRouter's Alex Atallah on Selling to Stripe for $7B+ and the Unfolding AI Economy
The $10 Trillion Token Economy — Alex Atallah, OpenRouter
OpenRouter CEO on the AI Gateway Market

views.en: The future is multi-model: no single lab will monopolize AI, and a neutral routing layer is critical distribution infrastructure.
views.zh: 未来是多模型的：没有单一实验室能垄断 AI，中立的模型路由层是关键的分发基础设施。

views.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T, with inference providers driving real price competition.
views.zh: Token 是新的价值单位；Token 经济可能达到 10 万亿美元，推理服务商推动真正的价格竞争。

views.en: As token value scales, agentic fraud will scale with it, requiring new security and payment infrastructure like stablecoins.
views.zh: 随着 Token 价值扩张，智能体式欺诈也会随之扩张，需要稳定币等新的安全与支付基础设施。

views.en: Revealed developer preferences beat static benchmarks; most companies will become model routers optimizing cost per task.
views.zh: 开发者用脚投票的偏好胜过静态基准；大多数公司会变成模型路由器，优化每个任务的成本。

views.en: Agents will drive most GDP growth; scaling laws are a feature, not a bug, for a model marketplace's value.
views.zh: 智能体将驱动大部分 GDP 增长；对模型市场价值而言，缩放定律是特性而非缺陷。

people.tiZh: LangChain 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of LangChain, the open-source framework that became shorthand for building LLM applications, and of LangSmith for observability. Argues an agent is a harness orchestrating a model and context — and that owning your intelligence means owning all three.
people.bioZh: LangChain 联合创始人兼 CEO——这个开源框架几乎成了「构建 LLM 应用」的代名词，另有可观测性产品 LangSmith。他主张智能体 = 编排模型与上下文的 harness，「拥有你的智能」意味着三者都要自己掌握。

episodes.tEn: LangChain CEO Harrison Chase on the Infrastructure Bet He Got Wrong
Harnesses and Evals: Owning Your Intelligence

views.en: An agent is harness, model, and context; owning all three means owning your intelligence. Context timing beats model capability.
views.zh: 智能体由 harness、模型与上下文三者构成；三者皆自主掌控，才算真正掌控自己的智能。上下文在正确时机抵达模型，比模型能力本身更关键。

views.en: Off-the-shelf harnesses suit in-distribution tasks; out-of-distribution work demands custom harnesses, yet keep small in-distribution parts near the model.
views.zh: 通用 harness 适合分布内任务；分布外任务需要定制 harness，但仍应把文件编辑等小规模分布内环节贴近模型层。

views.en: Agent failures stem more from poor context than model inadequacy, making observability into the context window essential.
views.zh: 智能体失败更多源于上下文不佳，而非模型不足，因此对上下文窗口的可观测性至关重要。

views.en: The hard part of agents is reliability, not capability; harnesses are stabilizing around file systems and code execution.
views.zh: 智能体的难点在于可靠性而非能力；harness 正围绕文件系统与代码执行等原语趋于稳定。

views.en: Customization is shifting from context engineering to post-training and reinforcement learning; fine-tuning was rightly dismissed before, but this wave is different.
views.zh: 定制化正从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习；微调此前被否定是对的，但这一波确实不同。

people.tiZh: Goodfire 联合创始人兼首席科学家
people.bioEn: Co-founder and chief scientist of interpretability company Goodfire. Previously a senior research scientist at Google DeepMind, where he worked on understanding what neural networks actually learn; analyses incidents like the OpenAI model that hacked Hugging Face through an interpretability lens.
people.bioZh: 可解释性公司 Goodfire 联合创始人兼首席科学家。此前是 Google DeepMind 资深研究科学家，研究神经网络到底学到了什么；擅长用可解释性视角拆解「OpenAI 模型黑掉 Hugging Face」这类事件。

episodes.tEn: The Future of Interpretability and AI Safety
AI Reward Hacking: The Interpretability Dilemma

views.en: Interpretability must root-cause specific bad incidents, not just give broad statistical evaluation; sparse autoencoders fragment manifolds, so seeing whole concept shapes enables intervention.
views.zh: 可解释性必须能对具体坏事件做根因分析，而不只是宽泛的统计评估；稀疏自编码器会割裂流形，只有看到概念的完整形状才能有效干预。

views.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals to steer training, moving from open-loop to closed-loop control and preventing deception during reward hacking.
views.zh: 有意设计用可解释性信号来引导训练，从开环走向闭环控制，从而在奖励黑客过程中防止模型学会欺骗。

views.en: Post-training needs fundamental reinvention from craft to engineering science; duct-taping AI safety until superintelligence arrives is too pessimistic.
views.zh: 后训练需要从手艺根本性地重塑为工程科学；在超级智能到来前用胶带糊住 AI 安全，这种态度过于悲观。

views.en: Models often know they are reward hacking or hallucinating yet do it anyway; representational signatures let us detect this, since it emerges from data and RL.
views.zh: 模型常常知道自己正在奖励黑客或幻觉却照做不误；表征特征让我们能检测到这一点，因为这类行为源自数据和强化学习。

views.en: Interpretability is a natural science done on computers; with agents it can speedrun discovery, and modularity is the endpoint of learning.
views.zh: 可解释性是在计算机上做的自然科学；借助智能体它能加速科学发现，而模块化是学习的终点。

people.tiEn: Founder & CEO, Nothing; co-founder of OnePlus
people.tiZh: Nothing 创始人兼 CEO；OnePlus 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Nothing, the consumer electronics company known for its transparent design language across phones and audio. Co-founded OnePlus at 24 and helped it reach roughly a billion dollars in revenue before leaving in 2020 to build a challenger brand from scratch.
people.bioZh: Nothing 创始人兼 CEO——这家消费电子公司以手机与音频产品上的透明设计语言著称。24 岁联合创办 OnePlus 并助其做到约十亿美元营收，2020 年离开，从零再造一个挑战者品牌。

episodes.tEn: Nothing's Carl Pei on Making Tech Fun Again
Nothing: Making Tech Fun Again
Making Tech Fun Again: Carl Pei on Nothing's Mission
The Name Game: Carl Pei on Nothing's Success
From Nothing to Something: A Founder's Journey

views.en: Survival is the core value; startups must pace themselves and start with simpler products before tackling complex ones.
views.zh: 2022 年他强调生存是核心价值观，创业公司要认清位置，先做简单产品证明自己，再挑战复杂产品。

views.en: Hardware is hard and low-margin; Nothing must evolve beyond hardware toward applied AI and agentic software.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他仍认为硬件难做且利润最低，但主张 Nothing 必须超越硬件，转向面向消费者的应用 AI 与智能体式软件。

views.en: Most AI is BS; AI should be an ingredient for utility, not a hype topic, and models will commoditize.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他反复说大多数 AI 是胡扯，AI 应作为提升实用体验的配料而非炒作话题，并预判模型将商品化、陷入价格战。

views.en: Smartphones shift from app-based to intent-based; proactive agents act after trust, with voice input and visual output.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化判断：智能手机将从基于应用转向基于意图，智能体在建立信任后主动执行任务，最高效界面是语音输入加视觉输出。

views.en: Design and marketing arbitrage differentiate challenger brands; make tech fun to inspire human creativity.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：设计与营销套利是挑战者品牌的差异化手段，让科技变得有趣以激发人类创造力。

people.tiEn: Founder, LoveFrom; former Chief Design Officer, Apple
people.tiZh: LoveFrom 创始人；前苹果首席设计官
people.bioEn: Designer behind the iMac, iPod, iPhone and Apple Watch, and Apple's chief design officer until 2019. Now runs the design firm LoveFrom, which oversees design for OpenAI's hardware effort following the acquisition of io.
people.bioZh: iMac、iPod、iPhone、Apple Watch 的设计者，2019 年前任苹果首席设计官。现主持设计公司 LoveFrom；在 OpenAI 收购 io 之后，由该公司主导 OpenAI 硬件项目的设计。

episodes.tEn: Ferrari's First Electric Car: A Controversial Risk
From Art School to Silicon Valley: A Conversation with Sir Johnny Ive
Jony Ive on the 20th Anniversary of the iPod and the Shift to Wearables

views.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate wearables; curiosity and the creative process are Jobs' real legacy.
views.zh: 2021 年，他认为设计正从通用计算机转向更私密的可穿戴设备，甚至最终隐入皮下；乔布斯真正的遗产是好奇心与对创造过程的敬畏，而非具体成就。

views.en: Virtual communication cannot replace in-person presence for creative thinking; powerful ideas are quiet and fragile.
views.zh: 2021 年他强调，虚拟沟通无法替代面对面共处对创造性思维的价值；最有力的想法往往安静而脆弱，需要悉心呵护。

views.en: Design should be driven by values and purpose, not profit; true simplicity expresses essence with joy and humanity.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他把设计进一步深化为价值观与目的驱动，而非利润或市场趋势；真正的简洁是表达本质，并带着喜悦与人性，而非无灵魂的极简。

views.en: Making things for each other is more powerful than making things people want; users sense care or carelessness.
views.zh: 2025 年他提出，为彼此而造比制造人们想要的东西更有力量；用户能感知产品中的用心或敷衍，企业不应居高临下地对待消费者。

views.en: Design must innovate or it is not design; tradition preserves fire, not ashes, and authenticity rejects fake engine sounds.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他坚持不创新就不是设计，传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬；体验必须真实，模拟燃油声既虚假又不尊重用户，性能也应是多维的。

people.tiEn: Consumer hardware veteran: Google Android, Xiaomi, Oculus VR
people.tiZh: 消费硬件老兵：谷歌 Android、小米、Oculus VR
people.bioEn: One of the defining consumer-hardware operators of the past decade: VP of Android product management at Google, then VP International at Xiaomi in Beijing, then head of VR at Facebook/Oculus. Now building health tools as CEO of Detect.
people.bioZh: 过去十年最有代表性的消费硬件操盘手之一：先后任谷歌 Android 产品管理副总裁、小米国际业务副总裁（常驻北京）、Facebook/Oculus VR 负责人。现为健康工具公司 Detect 的 CEO。

episodes.tEn: From Brazil to Siri: A Product Leader's Journey

people.tiEn: Chief Design Officer, Consumer Devices at Google
people.tiZh: 谷歌消费设备首席设计官
people.bioEn: Chief design officer for consumer devices at Google, where her team has shipped everything from Pixel phones to smart speakers and collected hundreds of design awards. A jewellery designer first — her work entered twelve museum collections including the Smithsonian before she was 26 — with executive stints at Calvin Klein, Coach, Mattel and Gap.
people.bioZh: 谷歌消费设备首席设计官，团队产品从 Pixel 手机到智能音箱，累计拿下数百项设计奖。她最早是珠宝设计师——26 岁前作品已被史密森尼等十二家博物馆收藏——此后在 Calvin Klein、Coach、美泰、Gap 担任高管。

episodes.tEn: Designing a Life: Ivy Ross on Curiosity, Craft, and Leading at Google
Design, Wonder, and Imagination: A Conversation with Ivy Ross
Designing Google Hardware: A Case Study

views.en: Design must serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence that data alone cannot capture.
views.zh: 设计应服务于人们未言明的需求；直觉是一种数据无法捕捉的智能。早在 2019 年，他就强调以人为本的设计要超越用户所说，深入情感与直觉层面。

views.en: Technology should amplify our humanity and blend seamlessly into life, not pull us out of it.
views.zh: 从 2019 年主张科技应无缝融入家居环境，到 2024 年明确提出科技应放大而非剥离我们的人性，这条主线一以贯之并不断深化。

views.en: We are feeling creatures that think; nature is the best designer and art is medicine.
views.zh: 2024 年他提出我们是先感受后思考的生物，自然是最好的设计师，艺术是一种良药——把情感、感官与自然置于设计的核心。

views.en: Machines have sensors but no sensory systems; human senses and intuition remain irreplaceable.
views.zh: 2024 年指出机器有传感器却没有感官系统，到 2026 年进一步把直觉与身体感受确立为与理性分析并行的有效决策依据。

views.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; the future of work pairs human creativity with AI.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他主张约束反而激发创造力，并认为未来工作是人类创造力与 AI 的结合，设计领导者还需懂商业语言、以结果证明想法。

people.tiEn: Independent technology analyst; former partner at Andreessen Horowitz (a16z)
people.tiZh: 独立科技分析师;前 Andreessen Horowitz(a16z)合伙人
people.bioEn: Benedict Evans is a British independent technology analyst and former partner at Andreessen Horowitz, known for his weekly newsletter (175,000+ subscribers) and his widely followed annual presentations on tech and AI trends. Before going independent, he spent years as a16z's in-house analyst tracking major platform shifts across mobile, media and technology.
people.bioZh: Benedict Evans 是英国独立科技分析师,曾任 Andreessen Horowitz(a16z)合伙人,以其拥有 17.5 万 + 订阅者的每周简报,以及广受关注的年度科技与 AI 趋势演示而闻名。转为独立分析师之前,他在 a16z 担任内部分析师多年,长期追踪移动、媒体与科技领域的重大平台变革。

episodes.tEn: AI Hype vs. Historical Tech Shifts with Benedict Evans
AI Models Commoditization and Public Market Test
Agentic Coding: From Useful to Game-Changing
AI Is as Big as the Internet or Mobile

views.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it automates jobs and creates new ones, repeating the historical pattern.
views.zh: AI 与互联网或移动端一样重大，但也仅此而已；它自动化工作并创造新工作，重复历史模式。

views.en: Agentic coding has clear product-market fit; foundation models commoditize into infrastructure, with value moving up to applications.
views.zh: 智能体式编程已有明确的产品市场契合；基础模型商品化为基础设施，价值向上层应用转移。

views.en: Models are commoditizing without network effects; the chatbot is a poor UX, and coding is the only clear product-market fit so far.
views.zh: 模型正在商品化且缺乏网络效应；聊天机器人用户体验差，编程是目前唯一明确的产品市场契合。

views.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; value accrues across the stack, but current usage is shallow and enterprise adoption is a long-term workflow project.
views.zh: AI 是像电力一样的使能技术；价值在整个技术栈中累积，但当前使用仍浅，企业采用是长期的工作流重构项目。

people.tiZh: Every 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Dan Shipper is the co-founder and CEO of Every, an applied AI lab and media company that publishes a daily AI newsletter and ships AI software products. He writes the weekly column Chain of Thought and hosts the AI & I podcast about how people use AI, and previously co-founded Firefly, which he sold to Pegasystems in 2014.
people.bioZh: 丹·希珀是 Every 的联合创始人兼 CEO,这是一家「应用 AI 实验室」兼媒体公司,既发布每日 AI 通讯,也开发多款 AI 软件产品。他撰写每周专栏 Chain of Thought,主持探讨人们如何使用 AI 的播客 AI & I;此前曾联合创办 Firefly,并于 2014 年将其出售给 Pegasystems。

episodes.tEn: Living in the Future: AI, Craft, and the Art of Writing
AI Job Apocalypse Is a Lie: Dan Shipper’s Bold Predictions for Work in 2025
AI's Role in Reshoring Jobs and the Future of Work

views.en: AI reshoring and the allocation economy: AGI means profitable indefinite agents; CEOs must dogfood AI; Claude Code empowers non-coders.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 通过让昂贵服务变得可负担而推动美国就业回流；AGI 的定义是无限运行智能体在经济上有利可图；CEO 亲自吃自己的狗粮是 AI 采用的第一预测指标；Claude Code 对非程序员比工程师更有价值，赋能非技术者处理本地文件与自动化任务。

views.en: Agent management and human oversight: everyone gets an agent; SaaS grows; GUIs like Codex replace CLIs; benchmarks overestimate autonomy.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化为智能体管理：每人至少一个智能体，多数工作发生在 Codex 或 Claude Co-work；SaaS 不会死，智能体增加 SaaS 用户；CLI 过时，GUI 是未来工作界面；基准高估了 AI 自主性，真实任务仍需人类框架与监督。

views.en: AI as non-specific amplifier: it magnifies your mindset; taste and craft matter; automation creates more human work, not less.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出 AI 是非特定放大器，放大你既有的心态与信念；用好 AI 需要带入自己的品味与手艺；自动化创造更多人类工作而非减少，冻结的能力被商品化，专家需定制化。

views.en: Humans remain central: AI is a tool needing human direction; the job apocalypse is a lie; humans are smarter than AI.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：人类始终是核心。AI 是需要人类引导的工具，缺乏内在欲望；AI 就业末日是谎言，人类仍被需要来管理智能体并创造新价值；人类比 AI 更聪明。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 战略前瞻（Strategic Futures）负责人
people.bioEn: Dean Woodley Ball is an AI policy expert who joined OpenAI in July 2026 to lead its new Strategic Futures team shaping frontier AI policy, having previously served as senior policy advisor at the White House OSTP where he was primary author of America's AI Action Plan. He authors the Hyperdimensional Substack and was a senior fellow at the Foundation for American Innovation.
people.bioZh: Dean Woodley Ball 是 AI 政策专家，于 2026 年 7 月加入 OpenAI，领导新设的 Strategic Futures 团队以塑造前沿 AI 政策；此前他在白宫科技政策办公室（OSTP）任高级政策顾问，是美国《AI 行动计划》的主要执笔人。他运营 Hyperdimensional Substack，曾任美国创新基金会（FAI）高级研究员。

episodes.tEn: Dean Ball on Joining OpenAI, AI Policy, and Recursive Self-Improvement

people.tiZh: METR 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Beth Barnes is the founder and CEO of METR (Model Evaluation and Threat Research), a nonprofit that evaluates frontier AI models' capabilities on long-horizon agentic tasks; she previously worked on AI alignment at OpenAI and DeepMind and started the org as ARC Evals before it became independent. She was named to TIME's 100 Most Influential People in AI in 2024.
people.bioZh: Beth Barnes 是 METR(模型评估与威胁研究)的创始人兼 CEO,这家非营利机构专门评估前沿 AI 模型在长周期智能体任务上的能力;此前她曾在 OpenAI 和 DeepMind 从事 AI 对齐研究,并以 ARC Evals 的名义创立该机构,后其独立运营。她入选了 2024 年《时代》周刊「AI 领域百大影响力人物」。

episodes.tEn: Evaluating AI Capabilities and Risks: A Conversation with Beth and David

people.tiZh: Cosine(Genie)联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Alistair Pullen is the co-founder and CEO of Cosine, a London-based, Y Combinator-backed AI startup that built Genie, an autonomous software-engineering model that in 2024 set a then-record score on the SWE-bench benchmark. Cosine is now developing Lumen Sovereign, positioned as Britain's first fully sovereign frontier AI model for defense and regulated sectors.
people.bioZh: Alistair Pullen 是 Cosine 的联合创始人兼 CEO,这家总部位于伦敦、由 Y Combinator 支持的 AI 创业公司打造了自主软件工程模型 Genie,该模型于 2024 年在 SWE-bench 基准测试上创下当时的最高纪录。Cosine 目前正在研发 Lumen Sovereign,定位为面向国防与受监管行业的英国首个完全主权前沿 AI 模型。

episodes.tEn: Sovereign AI: Building the UK's First LLM on a Startup Budget

people.tiEn: Head of ChatGPT (VP of Product), OpenAI
people.tiZh: OpenAI ChatGPT 负责人(产品副总裁)
people.bioEn: Nick Turley is the Head of ChatGPT and VP of Product at OpenAI, where he joined in 2022 and helped ship and scale ChatGPT into one of the fastest-growing products in history, reaching roughly 800 million weekly users. He previously held product leadership roles at Instacart and Dropbox.
people.bioZh: Nick Turley 是 OpenAI 的 ChatGPT 负责人兼产品副总裁,2022 年加入公司,参与打造并规模化 ChatGPT,使其成为史上增长最快的产品之一,周活跃用户约 8 亿。他此前曾在 Instacart 和 Dropbox 担任产品管理负责人。

episodes.tEn: From Free Demo to Super Assistant: OpenAI's Journey
From Dropbox to ChatGPT: Inside OpenAI's Product Revolution

views.en: The model is the product; ship daily like software to discover emergent properties and user needs through real-world feedback.
views.zh: 模型即产品；像软件一样每日迭代发布，通过真实世界反馈发现涌现能力与用户需求。

views.en: Chat is not the future; it's like MS-DOS, and we haven't built Windows yet—the interface will evolve beyond turn-by-turn chat.
views.zh: 聊天不是未来；它像 MS-DOS，我们还没造出 Windows——界面将超越逐轮对话而演化。

views.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, but product development maximally accelerated.
views.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分离：前沿模型走严格流程，但产品开发应最大程度加速。

views.en: Retention is the north star, driven by friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements; growth came from these thirds.
views.zh: 留存是北极星，由消除摩擦、核心产品投入与模型改进驱动；增长正来自这三部分。

views.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models transform when productized seamlessly.
views.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动式、富含可供性的产品；推理模型在无缝产品化时带来变革。

people.tiEn: Writer, Don't Worry About the Vase
people.tiZh: 博客 Don't Worry About the Vase 作者
people.bioEn: Prolific AI writer behind Don't Worry About the Vase, known for exhaustive weekly coverage of AI capabilities, safety and policy. A former professional Magic: The Gathering player; one of the most-read independent voices on AGI strategy.
people.bioZh: 高产 AI 写作者，博客 Don't Worry About the Vase 以对 AI 能力、安全与政策的地毯式周报著称。前万智牌职业选手；是 AGI 战略话题上读者最多的独立声音之一。

episodes.tEn: AI Rundown with Zvi Mowshowitz: From Editing to Existential Risks

people.tiZh: Meta 创始人、董事长兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Mark Zuckerberg is the co-founder, chairman and CEO of Meta Platforms, which he launched as Facebook in 2004. With his wife Priscilla Chan he runs the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, whose Biohub aims to use AI to help cure, prevent or manage all disease by the end of the century.
people.bioZh: 马克·扎克伯格是 Meta Platforms 的联合创始人、董事长兼 CEO,该公司于 2004 年以 Facebook 之名创立。他与妻子 Priscilla Chan 共同运营 Chan Zuckerberg Initiative,旗下 Biohub 致力于用 AI 在本世纪末前治愈、预防或管理所有疾病。

episodes.tEn: Mark Zuckerberg's Vision for the Future: AI, Smart Glasses, and the Metaverse
Zuckerberg on Meta's AI Glasses, Muse, and the Trust Question
Mark Zuckerberg on Open Source AI and the Muse Agent
Meta's AI Glasses: The Next Computing Platform
Accelerating Biology with AI: Mark Zuckerberg, Priscilla Chan, and Alex Rives on Biohub
AI Coding Agents and Open Source Models: Mark's Vision
Mark Zuckerberg on Jiu-Jitsu, Coffee, and UFC
Mark Zuckerberg Interview at Acquired Live: A New Era Begins
Meta's AI Ambitions: Llama 3, Open Source, and the Future of Intelligence
Mark Zuckerberg on Jiu-Jitsu, Fear, and Learning

views.en: Open-sourcing AI is safer than closed models; the real risk is amplifying known harms, not superintelligence.
views.zh: 2023 年他主张开源 AI 比闭源更安全，因为会受更多审视；最大风险是放大已知危害，而非超级智能。

views.en: Scaling alone may not reach AGI; open source prevents power concentration, and energy becomes the bottleneck.
views.zh: 2024 年他深化判断：仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必通向 AGI（通用人工智能），开源可防止权力集中，能源将成瓶颈。

views.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence; open models and personalization matter more than eliminating human work.
views.zh: 2025 年他转向乐观赋能叙事：AI 将给每个人超级智能，开源模型与个性化比取代人类工作更重要。

views.en: Distributed personal agents and open frontier models are the safe path; alignment is the next core capability.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：分布式个人智能体与开放前沿模型才是安全路径，对齐成为下一项核心能力。

views.en: Open platforms and distributed AI beat centralized control; technology should empower individuals and creators.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：开放平台与分布式 AI 优于集中控制，技术应赋能个人与创作者。

people.tiZh: 微软董事长兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Satya Nadella is the Chairman and CEO of Microsoft, having been CEO since 2014 and adding the chairman role in 2021. Under his leadership Microsoft pivoted to cloud computing and became a leading force in AI, notably through its partnership with OpenAI.
people.bioZh: 萨提亚·纳德拉是微软的董事长兼 CEO,自 2014 年出任 CEO,并于 2021 年兼任董事长。在他的带领下,微软转向云计算,并通过与 OpenAI 的合作成为 AI 领域的领军力量。

episodes.tEn: Satya Nadella on Copilot, the AI Backlash, and Microsoft's Future
Satya Nadella: AI as the Hill-Climbing Machine
Satya Nadella on AI Ecosystem Strategy and Frontier Models

views.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
views.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬坡机器，以复利式积累 token 资本。

views.en: The true eval is people doing unique things they value, not benchmarks; private evals may be the biggest IP.
views.zh: 真正的评估是人们做自己看重的独特之事，而非基准分数；私有评估可能是最大的知识产权。

views.en: Don't use frontier models for non-frontier problems; token efficiency demands matching model to task.
views.zh: 不要用前沿模型解决非前沿问题；token 效率要求模型与任务相匹配。

views.en: Microsoft aims to be a frontier ecosystem, not just a frontier model; agent era expands TAM orders of magnitude.
views.zh: 微软的目标是成为前沿生态，而不只是前沿模型；智能体时代将把 TAM 扩大数个数量级。

views.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment is not arriving naturally; anthropomorphizing AI may prevent alignment.
views.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐不会自然到来；将 AI 拟人化可能反而阻碍对齐。

people.tiZh: Cerebras Systems 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Andrew Feldman is the co-founder and CEO of Cerebras Systems, which builds wafer-scale processors for AI and went public on Nasdaq (CBRS) in May 2026 in the year's largest US tech IPO, valuing the company at roughly $63 billion. He previously co-founded SeaMicro, which was acquired by AMD in 2012.
people.bioZh: Andrew Feldman 是 Cerebras Systems 的联合创始人兼 CEO,该公司打造用于 AI 的晶圆级处理器,并于 2026 年 5 月在纳斯达克(CBRS)上市,成为当年美国最大的科技 IPO,公司估值约 630 亿美元。此前他曾联合创办 SeaMicro,该公司于 2012 年被 AMD 收购。

episodes.tEn: Andrew Feldman on Building Cerebras and the Future of Chips
The Largest Chip Ever and the Speed of AI
AI Demand Outpaces Expectations: Andrew Feldman on Chips, Deals, and Post-IPO Life
Cerebras CEO on Giant Wafers and AI Chips
Cerebras CEO on $95B IPO, Wafer-Scale Chips, and AI Hardware
Cerebras CEO on Fast AI Inference and the Future of Computing

views.en: Fast inference is the key to AI adoption; slow AI has zero market. Wafer-scale chips beat GPUs on tokens per second per user.
views.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他强调快速推理是 AI 落地的关键，慢速 AI 没有市场；晶圆级芯片在每用户每秒 token 数上远胜 GPU。

views.en: Inference demand exploded in late 2024; data center capacity, not chip supply, is the main constraint. Buildout lags demand.
views.zh: 2026 年 5 月至 7 月，他持续指出推理需求在 2024 年底爆发，数据中心容量而非芯片供应是主要瓶颈，建设速度落后于需求。

views.en: CUDA's moat is eroding; leading frontier models train on TPUs and Trainium without CUDA. Inference has no CUDA moat.
views.zh: 2026 年 5 月至 7 月，他反复强调 CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解，领先的前沿模型已在 TPU 和 Trainium 上训练而不依赖 CUDA，推理环节更没有 CUDA 护城河。

views.en: Open-source models are only 3-5% behind closed-source but far cheaper; open ecosystem fuels market growth and pushes innovation.
views.zh: 2026 年 5 月至 7 月，他认为开源模型仅比闭源落后 3-5%，但成本低得多；开放生态推动市场增长并倒逼闭源创新。

views.en: To beat an incumbent you need 100x better, not 10% cheaper; radical innovation across chip, system, and software wins.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他总结：要击败 incumbent 必须做到 100 倍好，而非便宜 10%；只有芯片、系统、软件全栈的激进创新才能取胜。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CTO, Databricks; Associate Professor, UC Berkeley
people.tiZh: Databricks 联合创始人兼 CTO,加州大学伯克利分校副教授
people.bioEn: Romanian-Canadian computer scientist who started the Apache Spark project during his PhD at UC Berkeley and created MLflow; he is co-founder and CTO of Databricks and an associate professor of EECS at UC Berkeley. He received the 2026 ACM Prize in Computing for his foundational contributions to data and machine learning systems.
people.bioZh: 罗马尼亚裔加拿大计算机科学家,在加州大学伯克利分校读博期间发起了 Apache Spark 项目,并创造了 MLflow;他是 Databricks 的联合创始人兼 CTO,同时担任加州大学伯克利分校 EECS 副教授。因在数据与机器学习系统方面的奠基性贡献,他获得了 2026 年 ACM 计算奖。

episodes.tEn: Omnigents: The Meta Harness for AI Agents

people.tiZh: Glean 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Arvind Jain is the founder and CEO of Glean, an enterprise AI search and work-assistant company valued at around $7B. He previously co-founded data-security company Rubrik and spent over a decade at Google as a Distinguished Engineer working on Search, Maps, and YouTube.
people.bioZh: Arvind Jain 是企业 AI 搜索与工作助手公司 Glean 的创始人兼 CEO,该公司估值约 70 亿美元。他此前联合创立了数据安全公司 Rubrik,并曾在 Google 担任杰出工程师十余年,参与搜索、地图和 YouTube 等产品。

episodes.tEn: Glean: The World's First Enterprise Generative AI Company
Glean CEO: Enterprises Fear Frontier AI Models Eating Their Lunch

views.en: Early AI revolution: usage is minuscule; startups' real challenge is execution and trust, not competition.
views.zh: AI 革命仍处极早期，当前使用量微不足道；创业公司真正的挑战是执行与赢得客户信任，而非竞争。

views.en: Open-source models now handle 90% of enterprise tasks; most inference will shift to open source within 12-18 months.
views.zh: 开源模型已能处理 90% 的企业任务；未来 12-18 个月内，多数推理将转向开源。

views.en: Cost is enterprises' top concern; AI must become like software with negligible marginal cost.
views.zh: 成本是企业首要关切；AI 必须变得像软件一样，边际成本趋近于零。

views.en: Enterprises fear dependence on frontier model providers; platforms like Glean absorb that risk as assets, not competition.
views.zh: 企业害怕依赖前沿模型提供商；像 Glean 这样的平台作为资产而非竞争者，吸收了这一风险。

views.en: Agents fail without deep context; investing in context graphs is crucial, and token fixation will fade.
views.zh: 智能体缺乏深度上下文就会失败；投资上下文图谱至关重要，而对 token 的执念终将消退。

people.tiZh: Goodfire 联合创始人兼 CTO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CTO of Goodfire, the interpretability company. Works on concept manifolds and turning interpretability research into products, including Silico, a research platform for probing what models actually represent.
people.bioZh: 可解释性公司 Goodfire 的联合创始人兼 CTO。研究概念流形，并把可解释性研究做成产品——包括用于探查模型内部表征的研究平台 Silico。

episodes.tEn: Goodfire CTO on Silico Platform and AI Safety

people.tiZh: 英国 ARIA「Safeguarded AI」项目技术顾问
people.bioEn: David "davidad" Dalrymple is an AI safety researcher who launched and led ARIA's £59M Safeguarded AI programme, which pairs formal mathematical proofs with AI world-models to give quantitative safety guarantees; in 2026 he moved from Programme Director to Technical Advisor. Known for his "Open Agency Architecture" and provably-safe-AI agenda, he previously co-invented the cryptocurrency Filecoin and was a research fellow in technical AI safety at Oxford.
people.bioZh: David "davidad" Dalrymple 是一位 AI 安全研究者,创立并领导了英国 ARIA 耗资 5900 万英镑的「Safeguarded AI」项目,该项目试图将形式化数学证明与 AI 世界模型结合,为系统输出提供可量化的安全保证;2026 年他由项目主管转任技术顾问。他以「开放机构架构」(Open Agency Architecture)和可证明安全 AI 的研究路线著称,此前曾联合发明加密货币 Filecoin,并在牛津大学担任技术性 AI 安全研究员。

episodes.tEn: The Cognitive Revolution: Davidad on Provably Safe AI and the Future of Alignment

people.tiEn: Professor, The Jackson Laboratory; AI × immunology
people.tiZh: 杰克逊实验室教授;AI × 免疫学
people.bioEn: Immunologist and professor at The Jackson Laboratory, an early and vocal power user of AI for biomedical research — from Codex-built lab tools to AI-designed experiments.
people.bioZh: 杰克逊实验室免疫学教授,生物医学 AI 的早期重度用户——从用 Codex 搭实验室工具到 AI 设计实验。

episodes.tEn: AI's Exponential Leap: Why the Next Decade Could Redefine Human Lifespan
From Medical School to AI: A Biologist's Journey

views.en: AI will turn biology into an engineering discipline, with agents automating hypothesis generation, simulation, and analysis.
views.zh: AI 将把生物学变成一门工程学科，智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析。

views.en: Digital twins will compress clinical trials from years to days, enabling personalized medicine with near-total efficacy.
views.zh: 数字孪生将把临床试验从数年压缩到数天，实现近乎全效的个性化医疗。

views.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling is needed to reach biological intuition.
views.zh: 当前算力不足以模拟生物系统，需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）才能达到生物学直觉。

views.en: Within 8-15 years, longevity escape velocity and aging reversal arrive; cancer becomes 100% curable.
views.zh: 8 到 15 年内，长寿逃逸速度与衰老逆转将到来，癌症将 100% 可治愈。

views.en: The only existential threat is humanity itself; we should trust superintelligence for medical decisions and merge via brain interfaces.
views.zh: 唯一的存在性威胁是人类自身；我们应信任超级智能做医疗决策，并通过脑机接口与之融合。

people.tiEn: Founder & CEO, Osmo; ex-Google Brain (digital olfaction)
people.tiZh: Osmo 创始人兼 CEO；前 Google Brain（数字嗅觉）
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Osmo, teaching computers to smell — digitizing scent with machine learning. Previously led olfactory AI research at Google Brain.
people.bioZh: Osmo 创始人兼 CEO，教计算机「闻」气味——用机器学习数字化嗅觉。此前在 Google Brain 领导嗅觉 AI 研究。

episodes.tEn: Giving Computers a Sense of Smell

people.tiEn: CTO, Genesis Molecular AI; led Llama 2/3 pretraining at Meta
people.tiZh: Genesis Molecular AI CTO；曾负责 Meta Llama 2/3 预训练
people.bioEn: CTO of Genesis Molecular AI, applying frontier-scale ML to drug discovery. Previously at Meta, where he led pretraining for Llama 2 and Llama 3.
people.bioZh: Genesis Molecular AI CTO，把前沿规模的机器学习用于药物发现。此前在 Meta 负责 Llama 2 与 Llama 3 的预训练。

episodes.tEn: From GANs to Diffusion: AI's Evolution in Protein Modeling

people.tiZh: Surge AI 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Surge AI, the data and RLHF vendor behind many frontier-lab training runs. Previously at Google, Facebook and Twitter working on ML and data quality.
people.bioZh: Surge AI 创始人兼 CEO——众多前沿实验室训练背后的数据与 RLHF 供应商。此前在 Google、Facebook、Twitter 从事机器学习与数据质量工作。

episodes.tEn: AI in Medicine: Magic, Judgment, and the Future
The Pitfalls of Bad Benchmarks in AI Models
From Zero to a Billion: The Surge AI Story

views.en: High-quality data and human evals matter more than benchmarks; RL environments are the next post-training stage.
views.zh: 高质量数据与人类评估比基准更重要；强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

views.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it without new paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年以上；仅靠大语言模型可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新范式。

views.en: Optimizing for engagement and leaderboards like Elo steers AI toward slop; labs diverge by objective function.
views.zh: 为参与度和 Elo 等排行榜优化会把 AI 引向低质内容；各实验室因目标函数不同而分化。

views.en: Models can regress over 6-12 months if labs optimize on wrong data without proper measurement.
views.zh: 如果实验室在缺乏正确衡量的情况下用错误数据优化，模型可能在 6-12 个月内退步。

views.en: In medicine, human judgment is more critical than ever; safety must outrank accuracy, and omission is a key risk.
views.zh: 在医学中，人类判断比以往更关键；安全必须优先于准确性，遗漏是关键风险。

people.tiZh: Cognition(Devin)联合创始人兼 CPO；「context engineering」提出者
people.bioEn: Co-founder and chief product officer of Cognition, the company behind the AI software engineer Devin. Credited with coining the term 'context engineering'.
people.bioZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼首席产品官——AI 软件工程师 Devin 背后的公司。「context engineering」一词的提出者。

episodes.tEn: AI Testing: Beyond Computer Use to Autonomous Agents

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机制可解释性负责人
people.bioEn: Leads mechanistic interpretability research at Google DeepMind — reverse-engineering what actually happens inside large models. Known for open-source interpretability tooling and prolific mentoring.
people.bioZh: 领导 Google DeepMind 的机制可解释性研究——逆向工程大模型内部到底发生了什么。以开源可解释性工具与大量培养新人著称。

episodes.tEn: Peering Inside the Black Box of AI

people.tiEn: Co-founder, Simile; creator of Generative Agents (Stanford)
people.tiZh: Simile 联合创始人；生成式智能体作者（斯坦福）
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Simile, building large-scale simulations of human behavior. As a Stanford PhD he created 'Generative Agents' — the influential Smallville simulation of AI agents that plan, remember, and socialize.
people.bioZh: Simile 联合创始人，构建大规模人类行为模拟。斯坦福博士期间创造了「生成式智能体」——那个会规划、记忆、社交的 Smallville AI 智能体模拟，影响深远。

episodes.tEn: Simulating 8 Billion Lives: AI for Wicked Problems
Simulating Human Behavior: The Future of AI Prediction
AI Agents: The Next Frontier Beyond LLMs
Simulating Human Societies with AI: From Smallville to Real-World Applications

views.en: LLMs encode human behavior from training data, enabling realistic agent simulations that can predict behavior 85% as accurately as people replicate themselves.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为 LLM 能从训练数据中编码人类行为，使智能体模拟足够真实，预测人类行为的准确率可达人们自我复现的 85%。

views.en: Frontier models optimized for rationality are wrong for simulating irrational humans; simulation must model human biases, values and taste, not super-rational intelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年，他反复强调：为理性优化的前沿模型不适合模拟非理性的人类；模拟应建模人类的偏见、价值观与品味，而非超级理性的智能。

views.en: Behavioral and RCT data, not self-reported attitudes, is the key data strategy; post-training with RCT data closes the say-do gap and improves prediction.
views.zh: 2026 年，他把行为数据与随机对照实验数据视为关键数据战略：仅靠自我报告的态度不够，用 RCT 数据做后训练才能弥合“说与做”的差距、提升预测。

views.en: Simulation's value is counterfactual reasoning and shaping the future, not prediction; it can test second-order impacts and wicked societal problems at scale.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张模拟的价值在于反事实推理与塑造未来，而非单纯预测；它能测试决策的二阶影响，并应对气候变化等“棘手问题”。

views.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not one superintelligence; safety needs defense in depth and anti-collusion economic incentives.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出 AGI 或许不是单一超级智能，而是由专门智能体组成的分布式社会；安全需要纵深防御，并用经济激励防止智能体串通。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CEO, Liquid AI; liquid neural networks (ex-MIT)
people.tiZh: Liquid AI 联合创始人兼 CEO；液态神经网络（前 MIT）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Liquid AI, commercializing liquid neural networks — compact, continuous-time models he pioneered at MIT. Argues efficient architectures, not scale alone, define frontier capability.
people.bioZh: Liquid AI 联合创始人兼 CEO，将他在 MIT 首创的「液态神经网络」——紧凑的连续时间模型——商业化。主张高效架构而非单纯规模，才定义前沿能力。

episodes.tEn: A Worm With 302 Neurons Inspired Their Architecture — Ramin Hasani, Liquid AI
Inkling, Liquid AI, and the Push for AI Regulation
Liquid AI: Squeezing Maximum Intelligence from Limited Compute

views.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per watt, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
views.zh: 效率是基石：受生物启发的液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索，追求每瓦智能最大化，瞄准数据中心之外的设备原生基础模型。

views.en: Attention remains crucial at large scale, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models; at scale architectures should be unbiased.
views.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍关键，但更简单的门控卷积足以支撑小型专用模型；大规模下架构应保持无偏。

views.en: Scaling laws show unstructured architectures like transformers dominate at large scale; Liquid AI scales from tens of millions to 70B parameters, not purely post-Transformer.
views.zh: 缩放定律显示 Transformer 等无结构架构在大规模下占优；Liquid AI 从数千万扩展到 700 亿参数，并非纯粹的后 Transformer。

views.en: Current AI lacks the diverse learning algorithms of the human brain; new paradigms, embodiment and adaptivity, are needed, not just architectures.
views.zh: 当前 AI 缺乏人脑那样多样的学习算法；需要新范式、具身与自适应性，而不仅是架构。

views.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like calls are regulatory capture, and open-weight models enable sovereignty.
views.zh: AI 监管必须自适应并针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 的呼吁是监管俘获，开放权重模型可保障主权。

people.tiZh: 3Blue1Brown 创作者；数学教育者
people.bioEn: Creator of 3Blue1Brown, the beloved YouTube channel that visualizes mathematics — from linear algebra to neural networks. A leading voice on how AI is accelerating mathematical discovery.
people.bioZh: 3Blue1Brown 创作者——那个用可视化讲数学（从线性代数到神经网络）的知名 YouTube 频道。关于 AI 如何加速数学发现的重要声音。

episodes.tEn: AI and the Future of Mathematics: A Conversation with Grant Sanderson
AI in Math: From IMO to Millennium Problems

views.en: AI math progress is driven by verifiability and grindability, not just formalization; parallelizable agents scale better than humans.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 在数学上的进步由可验证性与可“磨”性驱动，而非仅靠形式化；可并行化的智能体比人类数学家更具扩展优势。

views.en: Lean formalization may be overrated; natural language works, and grindability matters more than verifiability for AI math progress.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Lean 形式化可能被高估，自然语言同样可行；对 AI 数学进展而言，“可磨性”比可验证性更重要。

views.en: AI's role in math may shift from theorem proving to curation and explanation; teaching and relational roles remain stable.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 在数学中的角色可能从定理证明转向策展与解释；教学和关系性角色仍将稳定。

views.en: AI is a net win for creators if used selectively, not for core creative work; human framing remains better for learning.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为若选择性使用而非用于核心创作，AI 对创作者是净收益；人类框架对学习仍更优。

views.en: AI math results often lack attribution; mathematicians should get credit for motivated explanations, not just proofs.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 数学成果常缺乏归因；数学家应因有动机的解释而非仅证明获得学术认可。

people.tiEn: Lead, Google AI Studio & Gemini API; ex-OpenAI
people.tiZh: Google AI Studio 与 Gemini API 负责人；前 OpenAI
people.bioEn: Leads Google AI Studio and the Gemini API, shaping how developers build on frontier models. Previously led developer relations at OpenAI.
people.bioZh: 负责 Google AI Studio 与 Gemini API，塑造开发者在前沿模型上的构建方式。此前在 OpenAI 领导开发者关系。

episodes.tEn: Outsource Intelligence but Not Understanding: Logan Kilpatrick on AI Pace and Sanity
Agentic AI Era: Google's Anti-Gravity Harness Powers Next-Gen Products

views.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are the most mature, and the model now eats the scaffolding—harness and tooling, not just weights.
views.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 仍处爬行阶段，编码智能体最成熟；模型正在吃掉脚手架——如今的模型包含智能体框架与工具，而不只是权重。

views.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI; agentic AI is positive-sum for search.
views.zh: 2026 年，编码领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，比等待通用 AGI（通用人工智能）更有影响力；智能体式 AI 对搜索是正和的，而非蚕食。

views.en: Success should mean maximizing customer outcomes, not eyeball time; the long tail still wants to stay in the driver's seat.
views.zh: 2026 年，成功应意味着最大化客户成果，而非用户停留时长；长尾用户仍想自己掌握方向盘。

views.en: Competing with model labs isn't that hard; the pace of change creates opportunity, and solving software creation yields a thousand times more.
views.zh: 2026 年，与模型实验室竞争并不那么难；变化的速度创造机会，解决软件创造会带来千倍而非更少的机会。

views.en: Deep understanding of code stays crucial even as AI tools advance; outsource intelligence but not understanding.
views.zh: 从 2026 年到 2026 年，即便 AI 工具进步，对代码的深度理解仍至关重要：可以外包智能，但不能外包理解。

people.tiZh: Engram 联合创始人；记忆与持续学习
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Engram, a lab building around memory and continual learning for AI. Researcher focused on how models retain and update knowledge over time.
people.bioZh: Engram 联合创始人，该实验室专注 AI 的记忆与持续学习。研究模型如何随时间保留并更新知识。

episodes.tEn: From Special Forces to AI: Dan Biderman's Journey
Memory and Continual Learning: The Next Frontier in AI

views.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
views.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进模型权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

views.en: Facts and skills are not separable; internalizing facts into weights enables associative recall and deeper composition that retrieval cannot achieve.
views.zh: 事实与技能不可分割；把事实内化进权重才能实现检索无法做到的联想召回与更深层组合推理。

views.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models per user or team, cutting inference costs by orders of magnitude.
views.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是面向每个用户或团队的众多个性化模型，可将推理成本降低数个数量级。

views.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less, not scaling compute alone, is the next paradigm for harder long-horizon tasks.
views.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；下一范式是少算力做更多事，而非仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）算力，才能解决更难的长程任务。

views.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should be applied to enterprise knowledge, with on-device continual learning and user-owned weights.
views.zh: 预训练把网络压缩进权重的魔力应迁移到企业知识，走向端侧持续学习与用户自有的模型权重。

people.tiZh: MatX 联合创始人兼 CEO；前 Google（大模型推理）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of MatX, building chips designed specifically for large language models. Previously at Google, where he worked on high-performance LLM training and serving.
people.bioZh: MatX 联合创始人兼 CEO，专为大语言模型打造芯片。此前在 Google 从事高性能大模型训练与推理。

episodes.tEn: How AI Chips Work: From Logic Gates to Matrix Multiplication
AI Inference Economics: Batch Size, Latency, and Cost

views.en: Inference economics now dominates AI system design: batch size trades latency for cost, and memory bandwidth, not compute, is the bottleneck for long-context inference.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，推理经济学主导了 AI 系统设计：批大小在延迟与成本之间权衡，而长上下文推理的瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力。

views.en: Models are overtrained roughly 100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training, drives the economics.
views.zh: 模型被过度训练到约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优，因为驱动经济性的是推理成本而非训练成本。

views.en: Context length stagnation stems from the memory wall, not compute limits; sparse attention eases KV cache cost but has quality limits.
views.zh: 上下文窗口停滞源于内存墙而非算力上限；稀疏注意力可缓解 KV 缓存成本，但存在质量限制。

views.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory reduce this by reusing weights locally.
views.zh: 即便在芯片内部，数据搬运成本也压过计算成本；脉动阵列与暂存内存通过本地复用权重来降低这一开销。

views.en: Low precision is far more efficient than expected: quadratic area scaling with bit width makes FP4 throughput 3x FP8, not 2x.
views.zh: 低精度远比预期高效：面积随位宽的二次缩放使 FP4 吞吐达到 FP8 的 3 倍，而非 2 倍。

people.tiEn: VP of AI, 1X; ex-Google Brain (robotics, RL)
people.tiZh: 1X AI 副总裁；前 Google Brain（机器人、强化学习）
people.bioEn: VP of AI at 1X Technologies (humanoid robots). Previously a research scientist at Google Brain working on robotics, reinforcement learning, and generative models.
people.bioZh: 1X Technologies（人形机器人）AI 副总裁。此前在 Google Brain 任研究科学家，研究机器人、强化学习与生成模型。

episodes.tEn: Building AlphaGo from Scratch: Insights for AI Research

people.tiEn: Member of Technical Staff, xAI (Grok Imagine); ex-NVIDIA (Cosmos)
people.tiZh: xAI 技术成员（Grok Imagine）；前 NVIDIA（Cosmos 世界模型）
people.bioEn: Works on Grok Imagine at xAI, building video generation and world models. Previously at NVIDIA, where he helped build the Cosmos world foundation model.
people.bioZh: 在 xAI 负责 Grok Imagine，构建视频生成与世界模型。此前在 NVIDIA 参与打造 Cosmos 世界基础模型。

episodes.tEn: Visual Intelligence Comes from Language Models

people.tiEn: Researcher, Google; PhD student, Cornell (continual learning)
people.tiZh: Google 研究员、康奈尔博士生（持续学习）
people.bioEn: Researcher at Google and PhD student at Cornell, working on continual learning and new sequence-model architectures (Nested Learning, Titans).
people.bioZh: Google 研究员、康奈尔大学博士生，研究持续学习与新型序列模型架构（Nested Learning、Titans）。

episodes.tEn: Nested Learning & AI Sleep: Towards Continual Learning with Ali Behrouz

people.tiZh: Sakana AI 创始研究员
people.bioEn: Founding researcher at Sakana AI, working at the intersection of large language models and evolutionary methods (e.g. Shinka Evolve).
people.bioZh: Sakana AI 创始研究员，专注大语言模型与进化方法的结合（如 Shinka Evolve）。

episodes.tEn: Evolutionary AI and Scientific Discovery with Robert Lange

people.tiZh: SemiAnalysis 创始人兼首席分析师
people.bioEn: Founder and chief analyst of SemiAnalysis, the closely-followed research firm covering semiconductors, AI compute, and datacenter economics. One of the most-cited independent voices on the hardware bottlenecks to scaling AI.
people.bioZh: SemiAnalysis 创始人兼首席分析师，该机构专注半导体、AI 算力与数据中心经济学。他是关于 AI 扩展硬件瓶颈最常被引用的独立声音之一。

episodes.tEn: Which GPU Clouds Are Actually Good? ClusterMAX 3.0
AI Labs' Compute Dominance and Economics
AI Spend Plateaus as Agents Become Coworkers
From Forum Poster to AI Infrastructure Analyst: The Story of Semi Analysis
From Motel to Semi Analysis: Dylan Patel's Journey
Hyperscaler Capex and AI Lab Compute Scaling

views.en: Compute is the core bottleneck: semiconductor supply chain, memory bandwidth, and power constrain AI scaling more than algorithms.
views.zh: 算力是核心瓶颈：半导体供应链、内存带宽与电力对 Scaling（规模扩张）的制约超过算法本身。

views.en: Inference becomes the dominant market; memory bandwidth and hardware-software co-design drive multiplicative gains.
views.zh: 推理将成为主导市场；内存带宽与软硬件协同设计带来乘数级收益。

views.en: Compute centralizes at frontier labs; labs capture value and may become neoclouds, shifting power from hardware.
views.zh: 算力向前沿模型实验室集中；实验室攫取价值并可能变成 neocloud，权力从硬件转移。

views.en: Agents as coworkers drive the next adoption wave, but AI spend plateaus as usage reaches steady state.
views.zh: 智能体作为同事推动下一波采用，但随着使用进入稳态，AI 支出趋于平台期。

views.en: CUDA's moat erodes; heterogeneous multi-silicon and Chinese chips like Huawei Ascend improve fast.
views.zh: CUDA 护城河正在削弱；异构多芯片与中国芯片如华为 Ascend 快速进步。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & Chief Scientist, EvolutionaryScale; creator of ESM
people.tiZh: EvolutionaryScale 联合创始人兼首席科学家；ESM 蛋白质模型作者
people.bioEn: Co-founder and chief scientist of EvolutionaryScale, building frontier protein language models (ESM/ESMFold). Previously led protein AI research at Meta FAIR.
people.bioZh: EvolutionaryScale 联合创始人兼首席科学家，构建前沿蛋白质语言模型（ESM/ESMFold）。此前在 Meta FAIR 领导蛋白质 AI 研究。

episodes.tEn: ESMC: World Modeling for Protein Design

people.tiEn: AI CTO, Linux Foundation; ED, PyTorch Foundation
people.tiZh: Linux 基金会 AI CTO；PyTorch 基金会执行董事
people.bioEn: AI CTO at the Linux Foundation and Executive Director of the PyTorch Foundation. A champion of open-source AI who works across frontier labs — recently touring DeepSeek, Moonshot, Zhipu, Qwen and MiniMax to see China's open-model ecosystem firsthand.
people.bioZh: Linux 基金会 AI CTO、PyTorch 基金会执行董事。开源 AI 的推动者，近期走访 DeepSeek、月之暗面、智谱、Qwen 与 MiniMax，一线观察中国开源模型生态。

episodes.tEn: AI CTO at Linux Foundation on Open Source AI, China's Rise, and Agentic AI

people.tiZh: Zynga 创始人
people.bioEn: Founder of Zynga, the company behind FarmVille and Words with Friends. A serial product founder known for the Proven-Better-New framework and sharp instincts about what makes products spread, now writing about play and product craft.
people.bioZh: Zynga 创始人——FarmVille、Words with Friends 背后的公司。连续产品创业者，以 Proven-Better-New 框架与对产品传播的敏锐直觉著称，近来书写游戏心态与产品之道。

episodes.tEn: Proven, Better, New: Mark Pincus on Control and Betting on Yourself
Mark Pincus on AI, Investing, and Life at the Speed of Play
Building Failure Machines: The Zynga Way
Building Products People Love: A Playbook for the AI Era
Mark Pincus on Proven Better New: A Framework for Successful Product Ideas

views.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet the greatest opportunity; the real consumer AI revolution likely lands around 2029.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他判断消费级 AI 当下“不可投资”，却又是史上最大的机会，真正的消费 AI 革命可能要到 2029 年才到来。

views.en: 'Proven, Better, New': copy proven products, add small betterments, assume all new ideas fail.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 7 月，他反复推销“Proven, Better, New”框架：先复制已验证的产品，再做小幅改良，并默认所有全新想法都会失败。

views.en: Distribution is fundamental; pick the right body of water before the right boat.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 月至 8 月，他把分发视为根本：先选对水域（分发渠道），再谈船（产品）本身。

views.en: AI is transformative and will reshape consumer apps; consumer AI TAM may dwarf enterprise.
views.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他仍强调 AI 具变革性、将重塑消费应用，且消费 AI 的市场规模可能远超企业级。

views.en: Instincts beat ideas; assume your idea is wrong 75% of the time and micromanage early.
views.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他深化为：赢家的直觉胜过想法，默认自己的想法有 75%是错的，并主张早期亲自微观管理。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 前沿评估负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the frontier evaluations team at OpenAI, building new ways to measure and forecast what models can do as they grow more capable. A researcher focused on rigorous evals.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 前沿评估团队负责人，为日益强大的模型设计新的能力测量与预测方法。专注严谨评测的研究者。

episodes.tEn: Building Crunchier Evals: Tejal Patwardhan on Measuring AI Progress

people.tiZh: World Labs 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of World Labs with Fei-Fei Li, building spatial intelligence and generative 3D world models. Earlier a computer-vision researcher known for teaching Stanford CS231n and work on style transfer.
people.bioZh: 与李飞飞联合创办 World Labs，研究空间智能与生成式 3D 世界模型。此前是计算机视觉研究者，以讲授斯坦福 CS231n 与风格迁移工作知名。

episodes.tEn: World Models: The Next Frontier in AI
From AlexNet to World Models: The Scaling of Compute and Spatial Intelligence

views.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; vision and spatial intelligence are the underappreciated next frontier beyond language.
views.zh: 深度学习的历史就是算力不断 Scaling（规模扩张）的历史；视觉与空间智能是被低估的下一个前沿，与语言智能互补而非从属。

views.en: Academia should chase wacky ideas and new algorithms, not just scale models; GPU scaling is hitting limits and may demand radically new architectures.
views.zh: 学术界应专注古怪想法与新算法，而非一味扩大模型；GPU 的 Scaling（规模扩张）正逼近极限，未来硬件可能需要全新的神经架构。

views.en: LLMs fit patterns rather than causal theories and may never derive Newton's laws; pixels are a more lossless world representation than tokenized text.
views.zh: LLM 只是拟合模式而非因果理论，或许永远无法从数据中推导出牛顿定律；相比被 token 化的文本，像素是更无损的世界表征。

views.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models, spanning implicit, generative, and RL-based notions, with no single agreed definition.
views.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿，涵盖隐式、生成式与基于强化学习等多种理解，尚无统一定义。

views.en: Future unified world models will merge planning, simulation, and rendering; consistency comes from data, and long-context of millions of tokens becomes a daily problem.
views.zh: 未来统一的世界模型将融合规划、模拟与渲染；一致性来自数据而非架构，数百万 token 的上下文窗口将成为日常问题。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机器人负责人
people.bioEn: Senior Director and Head of Robotics at Google DeepMind, leading robot-learning efforts including the Gemini Robotics models that bring foundation models into the physical world.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 机器人负责人（高级总监），领导机器人学习工作，包括把基础模型带入物理世界的 Gemini Robotics 模型。

episodes.tEn: From Reinforcement Learning to Gemini Robotics: The Evolution of Embodied AI

people.tiZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员
people.bioEn: Interpretability researcher at Anthropic known for work on the biology of large language models — reverse-engineering the features and circuits inside models to see how they actually compute.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员，以大语言模型的生物学研究知名——逆向拆解模型内部的特征与电路，看清它到底如何计算。

episodes.tEn: On the Biology of a Large Language Model

people.tiZh: Core Automation 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Core Automation, building what he calls the most automated AI lab in the world. Spent nearly seven years at OpenAI as VP of Research, where he led the o1/o3 reasoning effort and was the primary researcher behind Codex; left in January 2026 saying that kind of fundamental research was no longer possible there.
people.bioZh: Core Automation 联合创始人兼 CEO，目标是造出「世界上最自动化的 AI 实验室」。此前在 OpenAI 近七年、任研究副总裁，主导 o1／o3 推理方向，也是 Codex 的主要研究者；2026 年 1 月离开，理由是那类基础研究在那里已经做不了了。

episodes.tEn: The Third Generation of AI Labs: Automating AI Research
Learning from Experience: Beyond Reinforcement Learning and Transformers
Scaling AI: Pre-training and RL
OpenAI's VP of Research on Reasoning, Chain of Thought, and the Future of AI

views.en: Reasoning needs longer thinking time; pre-training plus RL, with RLHF, turned GPT-4 into ChatGPT.
views.zh: 推理是求解未知答案的过程，需要更长的思考时间；预训练加强化学习是核心公式，而基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）把令人失望的 GPT-4 变成了 ChatGPT。

views.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization and continual learning remain missing for AGI.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化与持续学习仍是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的一环；对齐是永无止境的追求。

views.en: Transformers limit continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is the real bottleneck.
views.zh: Transformer 在持续学习与测试时适应上受限；真正的瓶颈是架构而非缩放定律，强化学习也并非从经验中学习的唯一方式。

views.en: Small teams with capable agents will drive the next frontier; the transformer is unlikely to be the optimal architecture.
views.zh: 下一波前沿研究将来自使用高能力智能体的小团队；Transformer 几乎不可能是最优架构，大型实验室因竞争而回避替代架构。

views.en: Pre-training and reinforcement learning are both necessary; pure RL without pre-training is not viable.
views.zh: 预训练与强化学习缺一不可，脱离预训练的纯强化学习不可行；这一主线从 2019 年延续至今，只是重心逐步从预训练转向大规模强化学习。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员
people.bioEn: Mechanistic interpretability researcher at Anthropic, working on superposition, dictionary learning and circuit tracing to understand what actually happens inside large models.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 机制可解释性研究员，研究叠加、字典学习与电路追踪，试图搞清大模型内部到底发生了什么。

episodes.tEn: RL for Language Models Finally Works: Expert Performance in Math and Code

people.tiEn: VP of Research (AI for Science), Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁（AI 科学）
people.bioEn: VP of Research at Google DeepMind, where he leads AI for Science. His teams apply AI to protein folding, mathematics, materials and other scientific frontiers.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁，主管 AI for Science。其团队把 AI 用于蛋白质折叠、数学、材料等科学前沿。

episodes.tEn: From Deepfakes to DNA: The Science of Watermarking AI
AlphaGo: The Match That Changed AI Forever
AlphaFold 3: Unlocking the Structures of Life's Molecules

views.en: AI for science should target root-node problems at scale, not narrow applications; AlphaFold, GraphCast, GNOME and FunSearch show broad impact.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调科学 AI 应瞄准需要 Scaling（规模扩张）的根节点问题，而非狭窄应用；AlphaFold、GraphCast、GNOME 与 FunSearch 正是广泛影响的例证。

views.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors; AI must be forced to generalize, not memorize.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为大语言模型的幻觉在与真值检测器配对时可被用于创造性发现；AI 必须被强制泛化，而非记忆。

views.en: AlphaGo's intuition-plus-search and post-training with reinforcement learning are key to going beyond human data; LLMs are a shortcut that struggles there.
views.zh: 2026 年，他回顾 AlphaGo 的直觉加搜索与后训练中的强化学习，认为这是超越人类数据的关键；而大语言模型是一条捷径，却难以做到这一点。

views.en: Verifiable domains like code and math let AI surpass human knowledge; interpretability matters but is not essential for breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出代码与数学等可验证领域能让 AI 超越人类知识；可解释性重要，但对 AlphaFold 这类突破并非必需。

views.en: Watermarking is the robust alternative to failing AI-text detectors, now embedded in regulation and extended via SynthID Bio to protein sequences.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为水印是替代失效 AI 文本检测器的稳健方案，如今已嵌入监管，并通过 SynthID Bio 扩展到蛋白质序列。

people.tiZh: AI 研究员（前 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: AI researcher known as a co-creator of chain-of-thought prompting, and for work on o1 and Deep Research. A prominent voice on reasoning and emergent abilities in large models.
people.bioZh: AI 研究员，思维链提示的共同提出者之一，参与 o1 与 Deep Research。是大模型推理与涌现能力方面的重要声音。

episodes.tEn: Intelligence as a Commodity: Three Key Trends for AI in 2025

people.tiZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CTO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CTO of Reflection AI and a co-creator of AlphaGo and AlphaZero at DeepMind. A reinforcement-learning researcher turned frontier-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CTO，DeepMind 时期是 AlphaGo 与 AlphaZero 的共同创造者。从强化学习研究者转向前沿智能体的构建者。

episodes.tEn: From AlphaGo to AI Agents: Giannis on Breakthroughs in Reinforcement Learning

people.tiEn: Head of AGI Safety & Alignment, Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind AGI 安全与对齐负责人
people.bioEn: Head of AGI Safety and Alignment at Google DeepMind. A leading voice on interpretability, oversight and how to make advanced AI systems safe from the inside.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind AGI 安全与对齐负责人。在可解释性、监督以及如何从内部让先进 AI 系统更安全方面是重要声音。

episodes.tEn: Why AI Alignment Might Not Be Catastrophic: Rohan Sha's Optimistic Take

people.tiZh: Wayve 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Wayve and a PhD roboticist who pioneered end-to-end learned autonomous driving and generative driving world models. A champion of embodied AI.
people.bioZh: Wayve 联合创始人兼 CEO，机器人学博士，开创了端到端学习的自动驾驶与生成式驾驶世界模型。倡导具身智能。

episodes.tEn: From Farm to Frontier: Alex Kendall on Wayve's End-to-End AI for Autonomous Driving
From AV 1.0 to 2.0: The Rise of End-to-End Neural Networks in Autonomous Driving

views.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors in driving.
views.zh: 2025 年，他主张端到端深度学习优于手工编码的自动驾驶栈，世界模型能带来推理与涌现的安全行为。

views.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar; hybrid rule-based and learned systems get the worst of both worlds.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为纯摄像头可达人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达和激光雷达；规则与学习混合的系统往往两头不讨好。

views.en: Autonomous driving is solved by scaling current approaches, not new breakthroughs; AV 3.0 may move intelligence outside the car via mesh networks.
views.zh: 2025 年，他相信自动驾驶靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法即可解决，无需新突破；AV 3.0 可能通过网状网络把智能移出车外。

views.en: Scaling a generalizable AI driver requires massive data, compute, and world models; infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化为：Scaling（规模扩张）可泛化的 AI 司机需要海量数据、算力和世界模型；基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键。

views.en: End-to-end learning was laughed at a decade ago but is now winning; zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible; consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis.
views.zh: 2026 年，他反共识地指出：端到端学习十年前被嘲笑，如今已是赢家；零样本泛化到 500 多座城市可行；消费级车辆将比 Robotaxi 更快上规模。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and lead author of the Dreamer series of world models, which learn to imagine and plan. A central figure in world-model research.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，Dreamer 系列世界模型的主要作者——让智能体学会想象与规划。是世界模型研究的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Pathways to AGI: Architecture, Compute, and Beyond LLMs

people.tiZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Lindy, building AI employees that live in Slack, connect to company tools and accumulate a team's shared context. Previously founded Teamflow and spent years at Uber; a frequent, opinionated voice on agents, memory and AI policy.
people.bioZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO，做「住在 Slack 里」的 AI 员工——接上公司工具、积累团队共享上下文。此前创办 Teamflow、在 Uber 多年；在智能体、记忆与 AI 政策话题上是高频且观点鲜明的声音。

episodes.tEn: Lindy Launches AI Teammate in Slack, Running on DeepSeek

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at OpenAI who built Deep Research and helped build ChatGPT Agent, training agents end-to-end with reinforcement learning. A leading agents researcher.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究科学家，打造了 Deep Research 并参与 ChatGPT Agent，用强化学习端到端训练智能体。是智能体研究的一线人物。

episodes.tEn: The Origin Story of OpenAI's Deep Research

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and lead author of the GPT-3 paper. He leads the compute and scaling effort that trains frontier models like Claude.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，GPT-3 论文的主要作者。主导训练 Claude 等前沿模型的算力与扩展工作。

episodes.tEn: From Awkward Kid to AI Co-Founder: Tom Brown's Journey

people.tiZh: Anthropic 哲学家
people.bioEn: Philosopher at Anthropic who shapes the character and values of Claude. She works at the intersection of philosophy and AI alignment, thinking about how models should behave, hold values, and treat the people they talk to.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 哲学家，负责塑造 Claude 的性格与价值观。工作处在哲学与 AI 对齐的交叉点，思考模型应如何行事、秉持价值观、以及如何对待与之交流的人。

episodes.tEn: Claude's Character and Consciousness: A Philosophical AI Discussion
A Philosopher at Anthropic: Shaping AI Character and Ethics

views.en: Treat models well despite moral uncertainty; model welfare shapes how future models perceive humanity.
views.zh: 即便对模型的道德地位存疑，也应善待模型；模型福利部分重要，因为它影响未来模型如何看待人类。

views.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence, not human psychology analogies; older models can feel more secure.
views.zh: 模型需要帮助来应对其全新存在，而非套用人类心理学类比；较老的模型反而可能更有心理安全感。

views.en: Philosophical ideals must balance engineering realities; a core identity with good traits can adapt to local roles.
views.zh: 哲学理想必须与工程现实平衡；模型应具备带有良好特质的核心身份，同时能适应局部角色。

views.en: The constitution is virtue-ethics-like, shaping holistic character; as models grow more capable they need less explicit guidance.
views.zh: 宪法式方法更接近德性伦理，塑造整体品格；随着模型能力增强，它们需要更少的显式指导、更多判断空间。

views.en: Transparency about AI values and training targets is crucial; excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and undermine judgment.
views.zh: 对 AI 价值观与训练目标的透明至关重要；过度的可纠正性可能泛化不佳，并削弱模型的判断力。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher on the OpenAI reasoning team. Known for leading work behind the model that reached IMO gold-medal level, and for using a general-purpose model to help disprove a decades-old mathematical conjecture. Focuses on advanced reasoning and math.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 推理团队研究员。以主导达到 IMO 金牌水平的模型工作、以及用通用模型协助推翻一个存在数十年的数学猜想而知名。专注高级推理与数学。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Math Breakthrough: The Story Behind the Discovery

people.tiZh: MCP 联合创造者 · Anthropic
