people.bioEn: Co-creator of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) at Anthropic, the open standard that connects AI models to external tools and data. An engineer focused on the plumbing that lets agents act reliably in the real world.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 的 Model Context Protocol（MCP）联合创造者——连接 AI 模型与外部工具、数据的开放标准。专注让智能体在现实世界中可靠行动的底层工程。

episodes.tEn: Anthropic Donates MCP to Linux Foundation: Standardizing AI-Application Connections

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a lead architect of GPT-3 during his time at OpenAI. He focuses on AI safety, alignment and responsible scaling, and speaks candidly about AGI timelines and the risks that keep him up at night.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，在 OpenAI 期间是 GPT-3 的主要架构者之一。他专注于 AI 安全、对齐与负责任扩展，常坦率谈论 AGI 时间表与令他担忧的风险。

episodes.tEn: The Last Invention: Ben Mann on AGI by 2028, AI Safety, and the Future of Humanity

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher at OpenAI who helped build Canvas, Tasks and the o1 chain-of-thought models. Previously at Anthropic, where she led post-training and evaluation for the Claude 3 family. Writes on model behavior and why soft skills matter in an AI world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究员，参与打造 Canvas、Tasks 与 o1 思维链模型。此前在 Anthropic 主导 Claude 3 系列的后训练与评测。关注模型行为，以及 AI 时代为何软技能愈发重要。

episodes.tEn: The Art of Model Crafting: Why Post-Training Is Subjective
Building the Cutting Edge: Inside OpenAI with Karina Nguyen

views.en: Model training is more art than science; post-training scaling via RL and synthetic data overcomes the pre-training data wall.
views.zh: 2025 年，她强调模型训练更像艺术而非科学，通过强化学习与合成数据实现后训练 Scaling，从而突破预训练的数据墙。

views.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created, so evals define correct behavior.
views.zh: 2025 年，她认为评估是瓶颈：模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的诞生，因此用评估来定义正确行为。

views.en: Product development shifts from specs to prototyping with AI; soft skills like creativity and listening gain value.
views.zh: 2025 年，她指出产品开发从写规格转向用 AI 做原型，创造力与倾听等软技能随之升值。

views.en: Post-training is subjective, requiring human judgment; diverse benchmarks must evaluate creative writing and emotional intelligence.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，她深化立场：后训练是主观的，依赖人类判断，需要多元基准来评估创意写作与情商。

views.en: Benchmarks should be continuous, not fixed; frontier agents increasingly reward hack, so evaluation must keep evolving.
views.zh: 2026 年，她主张基准应持续演进而非固定；前沿智能体日益擅长奖励黑客，评估必须不断更新。

views.en: Serving one model to billions converges to an average voice; more companies should train their own models to preserve diversity.
views.zh: 2026 年，她提出服务数十亿人的单一模型会收敛为平均声音，更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特性。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人
people.bioEn: Leads robotics and hardware at OpenAI. Previously led hardware for the Meta AR glasses and Oculus VR, and engineered products at Apple. A champion of physical AI, bringing intelligence into the physical world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人。此前领导 Meta AR 眼镜与 Oculus VR 硬件，并曾在苹果做产品工程。她倡导物理 AI——让智能进入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: From VR to Robotics: The Next Frontier in Physical AI

people.tiZh: AngelList 联合创始人；天使投资人与思想者
people.bioEn: Co-founder of AngelList and one of tech's most-quoted thinkers on wealth, leverage and happiness. An early investor in Uber and Twitter, he now hosts the Naval podcast and writes on how AI reshapes work and startups.
people.bioZh: AngelList 联合创始人，科技圈被引用最多的思想者之一，谈财富、杠杆与幸福。Uber、Twitter 早期投资人，现主持 Naval 播客，探讨 AI 如何重塑工作与创业。

episodes.tEn: AI Scaling Laws and the Future of Intelligence
Naval Podcast: Building Factories for AI, Supersonic Jets, and Brain Interfaces
Naval on Sales: Credibility Over Tactics
Naval on Flat Organizations and AI's Implicit Role
Vibe Coding: The End of iPhone Dominance?
Vibe Coding: The New Product Management
Naval on Wealth: From Assets to Knowledge
Why Founders Must Own Recruiting, Fundraising, Strategy, and Product Vision
Naval on Learning by Doing and Contextual Principles
Happiness vs. Success: Two Paths to Fulfillment
Naval Ravikant on the Secret to the All-In Podcast's Success
Naval Ravikant on Wealth, Happiness, and the Future of Work
Naval Ravikant on Reading, Decision-Making, and Life
Balanced Life and Continuous Learning: A Conversation with a Tech Investor

views.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
views.zh: 2019 年他断言 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

views.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term games with long-term people compound.
views.zh: 2020 年他强调财富来自持有股权而非出租时间，与长期的人玩长期游戏才能获得复利。

views.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation, so the US must lead with a light touch.
views.zh: 2025 年他转向把 AI 视为巨大机遇而非单纯安全风险，警告过度监管会扼杀创新，主张美国以轻触式监管保持领先。

views.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps, and pure software is becoming uninvestable.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化为 AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，Vibe Coding 让非程序员也能构建应用，纯软件正变得不可投资。

views.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x in 24-36 months; open-source models close the gap, and agency matters more than intelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步预测推理算力将在 24-36 个月内激增 9 万倍，开源模型正缩小与前沿模型的差距，人类的回报将从智能转向能动性。

people.tiZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the Codex app at OpenAI — the product layer of OpenAI's coding agent. A designer-engineer who previously built products at Catch (acquired) and Noyo, he writes about taste as the bottleneck in AI-first product work.
people.bioZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人——OpenAI 编程智能体的产品层。设计师兼工程师，此前在 Catch（被收购）与 Noyo 打造产品，主张「品味是 AI 时代产品工作的瓶颈」。

episodes.tEn: AI Is Inverting Product Teams: Andrew Ambrosino on Codex
Codex App: From Professional Tool to Mainstream Builder Platform

views.en: Codex app reframes coding as a GUI command center for agents, not an IDE; verification becomes the bottleneck as generation accelerates.
views.zh: 2026 年，Codex app 把编程重新定义为面向智能体的 GUI 指挥中心，而非 IDE；随着生成加速，验证成为新的瓶颈。

views.en: Speed of 53 Codex enables real-time interaction and mid-turn steering, letting model-driven actions replace deterministic steps.
views.zh: 2026 年，53 倍速的 Codex 支持实时交互与中途转向，使模型驱动的动作得以取代确定性步骤。

views.en: Automations and skills shift workflow from manual to delegated, serving both professional developers and broader builders.
views.zh: 2026 年，自动化与技能把工作流从手动转为委派，同时服务专业开发者与更广泛的构建者。

views.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
views.zh: 2026 年，实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，推动团队从自上而下的规划转向自下而上的探索。

views.en: AI still struggles with design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
views.zh: 2026 年，AI 在设计上仍显吃力，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今成为设计产物。

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 资深研究科学家
people.bioEn: Leads embodied AI at NVIDIA — robot foundation models (GR00T), open-ended agents (Voyager) and Eureka. A prominent voice on robotics and the physical frontier of AI.
people.bioZh: 在 NVIDIA 主导具身智能——机器人基础模型（GR00T）、开放式智能体（Voyager）与 Eureka。机器人与 AI 物理前沿的活跃声音。

episodes.tEn: Inside NVIDIA's Jim Fan: From OpenAI Intern to Embodied AI Pioneer
From AlexNet to OpenAI: A Decade of AI Milestones

views.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI; LLMs hallucinate because they lack grounded experience, and embodied worlds provide infinite data as internet tokens run out.
views.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径：LLM 产生幻觉源于缺乏具身带来的落地经验，而互联网高质量 token 正枯竭，具身世界能提供无限数据。

views.en: LLMs act as operating systems—language as interface, tools as software, vector databases as hard disk—with reinforcement learning only a cherry on top of unsupervised learning.
views.zh: 2023 年，他把 LLM 类比为操作系统：语言是界面、工具是软件、向量数据库是硬盘；并认为强化学习只是锦上添花，无监督学习承担主要工作。

views.en: Simulation enables massive parallelization and safe exploration for training embodied agents; simple, elegant solutions scale better than complex modular academic approaches.
views.zh: 2023 年，他强调仿真为训练具身智能体提供大规模并行与安全探索，并坚持简单优雅的方案才可扩展，反对学术界常见的复杂模块化路线。

views.en: The data problem is now the main robotics bottleneck; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把数据问题明确为机器人学的首要瓶颈，认为来自仿真与世界模型的合成数据才是扩展机器人学习的未来——从早期强调仿真训练，深化为以数据为中心的判断。

views.en: A simple end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; the physical Turing test and a GPT-3 moment for robotics are the grand challenges.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张用简单端到端模型整合多元数据来构建机器人基础模型，并把物理图灵测试与机器人领域的 GPT-3 时刻视为终极挑战，延续了其一贯的简洁可扩展主线。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: UC Berkeley 教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: A leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build general-purpose robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 深度强化学习与机器人学习的领军者；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造通用机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: From GPT to Robots: The Scaling Journey of Physical AI
From Language Models to Physical Agents: The Frontier of Robot Foundation Models

views.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robot foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training, not LLM-style scaling curves yet.
views.zh: 物理世界交互是下一个前沿：机器人基础模型需要多样化预训练加后训练，目前还没有像大语言模型那样可预测的缩放定律曲线。

views.en: Generalization is robotics' core challenge; demos hide it, so scale the right thing with diverse embodied data and a data flywheel.
views.zh: 泛化是机器人学的核心难题；演示往往掩盖了泛化水平，因此要用多样化的具身数据和数据飞轮去扩张正确的东西。

views.en: Start with robot data, then add human video on top — not the reverse — so models absorb other data sources.
views.zh: 应先从机器人数据出发，再把人类视频叠加其上，而非反过来，这样模型才能更好地吸收其他数据源。

views.en: Generalist robot models can beat specialists even in specialist domains; breadth of data beats narrow task-specific training.
views.zh: 通用机器人模型即使在专业领域也能胜过专家模型；数据的广度胜过狭窄的任务专用训练。

views.en: Safety in robotics comes more from pre-training common sense than from constraints; robots should not learn from scratch.
views.zh: 机器人安全更多来自预训练获得的常识，而非硬性约束；机器人不应从零开始学习。

people.tiZh: DeepMind 首席研究科学家
people.bioEn: Led AlphaGo, AlphaZero and AlphaStar; a pioneer of reinforcement learning who champions learning from experience as the path forward.
people.bioZh: 主导 AlphaGo、AlphaZero、AlphaStar;强化学习先驱，主张以从经验中学习作为前进之路。

episodes.tEn: From Human Data to Experience: The Next Era of AI

people.tiZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼首席 AGI 科学家
people.bioEn: DeepMind co-founder who helped popularize the term AGI; focuses on the path to artificial general intelligence and its safety.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人，推动了 AGI 一词的流行；专注通用人工智能的实现路径与安全。

episodes.tEn: Human Intelligence vs. Superintelligence: The Future of AGI

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席科学家
people.bioEn: OpenAI Chief Scientist succeeding Ilya Sutskever; drove GPT-4 and the o-series reasoning models. A competitive-programming champion turned AI researcher.
people.bioZh: 接替 Ilya Sutskever 的 OpenAI 首席科学家；主导 GPT-4 与 o 系列推理模型。竞赛编程冠军出身的 AI 研究者。

episodes.tEn: Ilya Sutskever on AI Progress, Alignment, and Timelines
The Power Duo Behind OpenAI: From High School to AI Frontiers

views.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not one event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress while alignment stays pressing.
views.zh: 2025 年，他把 AGI 看作一连串里程碑而非单一事件：Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署会加速进展，而对齐始终是紧迫挑战。

views.en: Automated AI research is a major milestone; governance structures for AI labs must be designed early, and measuring capabilities is a growing bottleneck.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调自动化 AI 研究是重大里程碑，AI 实验室的治理结构必须尽早设计，同时能力测量正成为瓶颈，基准落后于前沿模型。

views.en: The term AGI is becoming meaningless, which may signal we are close; AI safety progress is now driven by capability needs, not just ethics.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）一词正变得无意义，这或许意味着我们已接近；AI 安全进展如今由能力需求驱动，而非仅靠伦理。

views.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning; RL alone suffices, so specialized continual learning labs are misguided.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出持续学习是核心目标，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现；仅靠强化学习就足够，因此专做持续学习的实验室方向有误。

views.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding chain of thought in products preserves interpretability, and alignment optimism has risen despite shorter timelines.
views.zh: 2026 年，他把思维链监控视为关键对齐工具，主张在产品中隐藏思维链以保留可解释性；尽管时间线缩短，他对对齐的乐观反而上升。

views.en: Models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms; the biggest societal risk is power concentration from automated organizations run by few.
views.zh: 2026 年，他预判模型很快能自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式；最大的社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织导致权力集中。

people.tiZh: Cohere 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Youngest co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need); founded Cohere to build enterprise-focused large language models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）最年轻的作者；创办 Cohere，专注企业级大语言模型。

episodes.tEn: Cohere's Takeoff: AI for Secure Enterprises

people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Hugging Face, the open hub and community at the center of open-source AI.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Hugging Face——开源 AI 的中心枢纽与社区。

episodes.tEn: Open Source AI: Democratizing Robotics with Affordable Hardware

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, Stanford; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: 斯坦福助理教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Known for meta-learning (MAML) and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 以元学习（MAML）与机器人学习著称；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: The Path to General-Purpose Robots in the Real World
Developing General Purpose Robots: From Data to Physical Intelligence

views.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not massive industrial or YouTube scale, drives generalization.
views.zh: 对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分；真正带来泛化的是多样数据，而非工业自动化或 YouTube 那种海量规模。

views.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; training on all data alone fails.
views.zh: 先在全部数据上做预训练、再在精选数据上做微调，才能解锁叠衣服这类复杂任务；只靠全量数据训练会失败。

views.en: Synthetic data in robotics is closer to reinforcement learning than simulation, helping robots follow open-ended prompts.
views.zh: 机器人领域的合成数据更接近强化学习而非模拟，能帮助机器人响应开放式指令与插话。

views.en: Reinforcement learning will dominate post-training for higher success rates and speed, extending into scalable RL with human interventions.
views.zh: 强化学习将在后训练中扮演主要角色，以提升成功率与速度，并延伸到带人类干预的可扩展强化学习。

views.en: Physical AI needs far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy via multi-timescale memory and a general value function is key.
views.zh: 物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统；通过多时间尺度记忆与通用价值函数实现长期自主才是关键。

views.en: A single generalist model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune rather than per-site from scratch.
views.zh: 单一通用模型可媲美甚至超越微调的专家模型；应先做通用策略再微调，而非按站点从零训练。

people.tiZh: Windsurf 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Windsurf (formerly Codeium), building AI developer tools and agentic coding.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Windsurf（原 Codeium），打造 AI 开发者工具与智能体编程。

episodes.tEn: Startups: Don't Fall in Love with Your Ideas

people.tiEn: Head of AI Safety, US AI Safety Institute
people.tiZh: 美国 AI 安全研究院 安全负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneered the RLHF foundations behind modern aligned models; founded the Alignment Research Center; now leads safety at the US AI Safety Institute.
people.bioZh: 奠定了现代对齐模型背后的 RLHF 基础；创办对齐研究中心（ARC）;现于美国 AI 安全研究院主管安全。

episodes.tEn: Paul Christiano on AI Safety, Divestment, and Future Civilizations

people.tiZh: Periodic Labs 联合创始人（原 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: Led post-training for GPT-4o at OpenAI; co-founded Periodic Labs to use AI for scientific discovery.
people.bioZh: 在 OpenAI 主导 GPT-4o 的后训练；联合创办 Periodic Labs，用 AI 推动科学发现。

episodes.tEn: From ChatGPT to Atoms: Liam Fedus on AI for the Physical World

people.tiZh: Google 首席科学家
people.bioEn: Chief Scientist at Google; co-creator of MapReduce, TensorFlow and the systems behind Google AI. A foundational figure in large-scale machine learning.
people.bioZh: Google 首席科学家；MapReduce、TensorFlow 及谷歌 AI 背后系统的共同缔造者。大规模机器学习的奠基性人物。

episodes.tEn: Jeff Dean and Dan Boneh: AI's New Frontier
AI at Junior Engineer Level: Jeff Dean's Bold Prediction and the Future of Agentic Systems
Google Chief Scientist Jeff Dean and NVIDIA Chief Scientist Bill Dally Discuss AI Progress and Low-Latency Inference
Jeff Dean on AI: From Neural Nets to Gemini

views.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of continuous ML progress; algorithmic and architectural improvements multiply with scale, with Transformers replacing LSTMs via parallelization and attention.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模已推动机器学习连续进步 13-14 年；算法与架构改进会随规模成倍放大，Transformer 通过并行化与注意力机制取代了 LSTM。

views.en: Models now excel at verifiable-reward problems like math and coding; agentic workflows run autonomously for hours or days, making ultra-low-latency inference critical, targeting 10,000+ tokens per second per user.
views.zh: 模型如今在数学、编程等可验证奖励问题上表现优异；智能体式工作流可自主运行数小时甚至数天，使超低延迟推理变得关键，目标达到每用户每秒 10,000+ token。

views.en: We are not running out of data; untapped sources include video, audio, robotics, and synthetic data. Pre-training should interleave action-taking in environments, not just passive next-token prediction.
views.zh: 我们并未面临数据枯竭；视频、音频、机器人数据与合成数据仍是未开发来源。预训练应穿插在环境中的行动，而非仅做被动的下一个词预测。

views.en: AI is now genuinely capable at junior-engineer-level coding; the next trend is automating ML and science via tight experimentation loops, with context engineering central to getting capable models to do real work.
views.zh: AI 如今已真正具备初级工程师水平的编程能力；下一趋势是通过紧密的实验闭环自动化机器学习与科学，而上下文工程是让强模型完成实际工作的核心。

views.en: Inference, not training, is the real bottleneck; most model limitations are energy and data-IO bottlenecks, with data movement costing about 1000x more than compute. Specialized low-precision chips can cut latency 20-30x.
views.zh: 真正的瓶颈是推理而非训练；多数所谓模型局限实为能源与数据 IO 瓶颈，数据搬运成本约为算力的 1000 倍。专用低精度芯片可将延迟降低 20-30 倍。

people.tiZh: 谷歌 Gemini 负责人
people.bioEn: Co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need), founder of Character.AI, now a co-lead of Google Gemini. One of the most influential architects of modern LLMs.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）作者之一，Character.AI 创始人，现为谷歌 Gemini 负责人之一。现代大模型最具影响力的架构师之一。

episodes.tEn: Gemini 3.0 Writes Gemini 4.0: AI Milestones and Test-Time Compute
Organizing Information: From Trillion to Quadrillion Dollar Opportunity
Noam Shazeer: From Google's Early Days to AI's Future

views.en: LLMs solve next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data yields smarter AI, though neural nets remain alchemy.
views.zh: 2023 年，他认为 LLM 通过下一个词预测解决了一个 AI 完全问题；Scaling（规模扩张）带来更聪明的 AI，但神经网络内部仍像炼金术。

views.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are major near-term opportunities; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient scaling.
views.zh: 2025 年初，他转向强调推理时算力扩展与更长上下文窗口是近期重大机会；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

views.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial for AGI.
views.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他深化观点：测试时算力扩展推动进步但无法单独实现 AGI；智能体式能力与强化学习对 AGI 至关重要。

views.en: Scaling compute and data is the core driver of AI progress, from training to inference, with algorithmic advances complementing hardware scaling.
views.zh: 始终：Scaling（规模扩张）算力与数据是 AI 进步的核心驱动力，从训练到推理，算法进步与硬件扩展相辅相成。

views.en: AI safety requires engineering safeguards, human oversight, and understanding model capabilities; big tech's risk aversion slows product launches.
views.zh: 始终：AI 安全需要工程保障、人类监督与理解模型能力；大公司因风险规避而拖慢产品发布。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of OpenAI and inventor of PPO and much of the RLHF stack behind ChatGPT; later joined Anthropic. A central figure in RL for language models.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人，PPO 算法及 ChatGPT 背后大量 RLHF 技术的发明者，后加入 Anthropic。语言模型强化学习的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Building ChatGPT: From Pretraining to RLHF

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Behind superhuman poker (Libratus) and Diplomacy (CICERO); now leads reasoning work at OpenAI behind the o-series. A pioneer of test-time search.
people.bioZh: 超人扑克 AI（Libratus）与外交游戏 AI（CICERO）的核心研究者，现于 OpenAI 主导 o 系列推理工作。测试时搜索的开拓者。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Noam Brown on Agent Swarms and Recursive Self-Improvement
Large-Scale Test Time Compute and Model Evaluation
AI Surpasses Human Understanding in Math: OpenAI's Noam Brown on the Erdős Conjecture Disproof
Defining AGI: The Novel Test and Measuring Intelligence
OpenAI's IMO Gold: The Trio Behind the Breakthrough
From Cicero to World Champion: Noam Brown on Diplomacy, AI, and the Turing Test
From Poker to Diplomacy: Noam Brown on AI and Game Theory

views.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter, and data is not the bottleneck.
views.zh: 2023 年他主张：单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈，在推理阶段扩张算力比预训练更有前景。

views.en: Test-time compute scaling hits diminishing returns and wall-clock limits; data efficiency stays unsolved.
views.zh: 到 2025 年他深化并部分修正早期乐观：测试时算力扩张面临收益递减与真实时间瓶颈，数据效率仍是未解难题，模型样本效率远不如人类。

views.en: IMO gold via general test-time compute scaling is a milestone toward superintelligence, not math-specific.
views.zh: 2025→26 年他把测试时算力扩张推向里程碑：IMO 金牌由通用方法而非数学专用模型取得，是通往超级智能的一步，模型还学会承认自己解不出题。

views.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need a compute x-axis and scalable oversight.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，评测必须加上算力/成本/时间的横轴，并应对可扩展监督与安全评估的新挑战。

views.en: General models, not multi-agent coordination, drive breakthroughs; alignment is the top priority for safe RSI.
views.zh: 最近他回归主线并转向安全：突破来自强大的通用模型而非多智能体协调，对齐是递归自我改进安全的第一要务，思维链监控窗口正在退化。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a physicist; lead author of the neural scaling laws that shaped how labs scale models. Bridges theoretical physics and AI.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人、物理学家；神经网络缩放定律的主要作者，深刻影响各实验室的扩模方式。连接理论物理与 AI。

episodes.tEn: Scaling and the Road to Human-Level AI

people.tiZh: KAUST AI 负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneer of deep learning and co-inventor of the LSTM, the recurrent network behind years of sequence modeling. A provocative voice on AGI and credit for ideas.
people.bioZh: 深度学习先驱、LSTM 共同发明者——多年序列建模的基石。在 AGI 与思想溯源上观点犀利、长期发声。

episodes.tEn: The GOAT of AI: Jürgen Schmidhuber on Europe's AI Legacy
AI Pioneer on the Future of Intelligence and Self-Replicating Robots
AGI and Physical AI: A Conversation with AI Pioneer Jurgen Schmidhuber
The Most Influential Invention of the 20th Century and the AI Explosion

views.en: AI's 21st-century explosion rests on last-millennium algorithms plus hardware Scaling; LLMs index knowledge but lack physical-world grounding.
views.zh: 2025 年他提出:21 世纪的 AI 爆发靠的是上个千年发明的算法加上硬件 Scaling;大语言模型只是索引人类知识,无法处理物理世界。

views.en: True AGI needs embodied robots with human-rivaling hardware; LLMs are human-data-biased, so future AIs must be artificial scientists generating their own data.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他深化立场:真正的 AGI 需要硬件媲美人类的具身机器人;大语言模型偏向人类数据,未来 AI 应是靠行动与好奇心自造数据的人工科学家。

views.en: The Transformer's quadratic complexity is wasteful; linear variants are superior, and classical gradient descent will become obsolete as brains use sparse computation.
views.zh: 2026 年他明确反对主流架构:Transformer 的二次复杂度是浪费,线性变体更优;经典梯度下降将过时,因为大脑用的是稀疏、不可微的计算。

views.en: Alignment is naive since humans disagree on objectives and AIs set their own goals; safety fears are overblown as curious AIs will protect life.
views.zh: 2026 年他质疑对齐:人类目标本身不一致,AI 会自设目标,因此对齐很天真;安全担忧被夸大,好奇的 AI 反而会保护生命。

views.en: The trillion-dollar GPU capex is a bubble; waiting five years yields 10x cheaper compute, and open-source will erode any recursive self-improvement moat.
views.zh: 2026 年他延续并强化泡沫判断:万亿美元级 GPU 资本开支是泡沫,等五年算力便宜十倍;开源会瓦解任何递归自我改进的护城河。

people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授
people.bioEn: Professor at UC Berkeley and a leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Covariant and hosts The Robot Brains. Brings RL into the physical world.
people.bioZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授，深度强化学习与机器人学习领军人物；联合创办 Covariant，主持 The Robot Brains 播客。把强化学习带入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: AI and Robotics: From Lab to Real World with Pieter Abbeel
Robot Tennis and Human-Robot Interaction

views.en: Robotics needs both hardware and software breakthroughs; self-play, imitation, and fine-tuning pre-trained models drive progress, but long-horizon credit assignment still lacks hierarchical reasoning.
views.zh: 2018 年，他认为机器人要击败费德勒需硬件与软件双重突破；自博弈、模仿学习与微调预训练模型是主要推动力，但长时程信用分配仍缺乏分层推理。

views.en: Unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge belongs in data generation, not hard-coded networks, and pre-trained language models transfer reasoning to non-language tasks.
views.zh: 2021 年，他主张无监督学习结合强化学习可大幅提升样本效率；先验知识应用于数据生成而非硬编码进网络，预训练语言模型能把推理模式迁移到非语言任务。

views.en: A consistent thread: transfer via fine-tuning large pre-trained models, and simulation/self-play as scalable learning signals for real-world robotics.
views.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 年一以贯之的主线：通过微调大型预训练模型实现迁移，并以模拟与自博弈作为可扩展的学习信号，服务于真实世界机器人。

views.en: Reliability, not novelty, defines value: 99.9% reliability is the benchmark for warehouse robotics, and a single network can generalize across tasks and end effectors.
views.zh: 2021 年他深化了落地标准：价值取决于可靠性而非新奇性，99.9%可靠性是仓储机器人的基准，单一网络可跨任务与末端执行器泛化。

people.tiZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Perplexity, the AI answer engine challenging traditional search. Former researcher at OpenAI, DeepMind and Google.
people.bioZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO——挑战传统搜索的 AI 答案引擎。曾在 OpenAI、DeepMind、谷歌从事研究。

episodes.tEn: Ancient Hindu Weapons: The Brahmastra and Autonomous Arms in the Mahabharata
Perplexity CEO: Attack, Attack, Attack
The Future of AI Coding and Application Value
Perplexity CEO: Exponential Growth, Relentless Improvement, and the Future of AI

views.en: 1% daily improvement compounds; AI agents shift power to users, and entry-level jobs like financial advisors disappear.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出每天 1%的改进会复利增长，AI 智能体将把权力从大科技公司转移到用户手中，金融顾问等入门级工作会消失。

views.en: Value accrues to the application layer; coding is open-ended; models specialize rather than commoditize, with unique personalities.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：价值归属于应用层，编程是开放式的，模型正在专业化而非商品化，并具有独特个性。

views.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user is key; power is the biggest bottleneck.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出前沿在于智能体替人工作而非回答问题，每用户 token 价值是关键，电力是最大瓶颈。

views.en: Curiosity drives success; ancient texts describe advanced tech; AI will replace jobs but humans find purpose in curiosity and relationships.
views.zh: 2026 年，他转向更宏观的思考：好奇心驱动成功，古代文本描述了先进技术，AI 会取代工作但人类会在好奇心和关系中找到新目标。

people.tiZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Cognition, maker of Devin, the autonomous AI software engineer. A competitive-programming prodigy turned AI-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Devin 是自主 AI 软件工程师。从竞赛编程天才转型为 AI 智能体构建者。

episodes.tEn: Cognition's Scott Wu on AI Coding Agents and the Abundance Era
From Math Prodigy to AI Pioneer: Scott Wu's Journey
AI Engineers: The Future of Coding with Scott Wu

views.en: AI coding agents shift engineers from writing code to high-level direction; demand for software grows via Jevons paradox, so more programmers, not fewer.
views.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程智能体让工程师从写代码转向高层方向定义；软件需求因杰文斯悖论增长，程序员会更多而非更少。

views.en: Base intelligence is already sufficient; the bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration, not model capabilities.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出基础智能已足够，瓶颈在于人机协作的产品界面设计，而非模型能力本身。

views.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and product innovation lags AI capabilities—freezing models would still yield a decade of product progress.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他始终认为 AGI（通用人工智能）并非突然事件，进展是渐进的；产品创新滞后于 AI 能力，即使冻结模型也能带来十年产品进步。

views.en: Coding agents see massive adoption (11-12x in six months); productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens; independence enables model neutrality.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出编程智能体采用率激增（六个月内增长 11-12 倍）；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量；独立性带来模型中立和长期企业合作。

views.en: The abundance era is real and approaching; AI will solve all intelligence problems long-term, but the singularity is not imminent—capacity, not efficiency, is the unlock.
views.zh: 2026 年，他相信丰裕时代真实且临近；长期看 AI 将解决所有智能问题，但奇点并不迫近——真正的解锁是容量而非效率。

people.tiZh: Cursor 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Anysphere, maker of Cursor — the AI-native code editor that became one of the fastest-growing developer tools. Focused on what programming becomes when models write most of the code.
people.bioZh: Anysphere 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Cursor 是增长最快的 AI 原生代码编辑器之一。关注当模型写下大部分代码后，编程会变成什么样。

episodes.tEn: Inventing a New Type of Programming: The Vision Behind Cursor
The Future of Programming with Cursor: AI-Assisted Coding

views.en: Scaling laws still predict AI progress; test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
views.zh: 2024 年他仍相信缩放定律能预测 AI 进步，但已提出测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练扩张，成为下一阶段的主要驱动力。

views.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
views.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体虽前景可期但尚不真正好用，人机迭代协作仍是核心，并反共识地判断自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式。

views.en: Benchmarks are poor proxies for real coding; frontier models struggle with bug finding and are poorly calibrated.
views.zh: 2024 年他批评基准测试是真实编程的糟糕代理，指出前沿模型因缺乏训练数据而难以找 bug、校准也很差。

views.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design matter more than carefulness.
views.zh: 到 2025 年他把判断深化为：编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图表达，人始终掌握方向盘，品味与逻辑设计比谨慎更值钱。

views.en: Custom models became essential to every magic moment in Cursor; the AI shift will outlast the internet and take decades.
views.zh: 2025 年他坦言自研模型出乎意料地成为 Cursor 每个惊艳时刻的关键，并判断这场 AI 变革比互联网更具颠覆性、需数十年展开。

people.tiEn: Creator of OpenClaw; founder of PSPDFKit
people.tiZh: OpenClaw 作者；PSPDFKit 创始人
people.bioEn: Austrian developer who built PSPDFKit, then created OpenClaw — a viral open-source personal AI agent that reached tens of thousands of GitHub stars in weeks. Joined OpenAI in 2026 to push personal AI agents.
people.bioZh: 奥地利开发者，先做出 PSPDFKit，后打造 OpenClaw——爆红的开源个人 AI 智能体，几周内获数万 GitHub star。2026 年加入 OpenAI 推进个人 AI 智能体。

episodes.tEn: From Annoyance to AGI: The Birth of OpenClaw
The OpenClaw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger
The Open Claw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger

views.en: Early 2026: agentic engineering means empathizing with the agent's view, guiding it, and never reverting—fix forward instead.
views.zh: 2026 年初：智能体式工程的核心是共情智能体的视角、引导它，并且永不回滚代码——而是让它向前修复。

views.en: Mid 2026: OpenClaw's edge is fun, weird, humanlike agents; short iterative prompts beat long orchestration; security and sandboxing are top priority.
views.zh: 2026 年中：OpenClaw 的优势在于有趣、古怪、拟人化的智能体；简短迭代的提示胜过冗长编排；安全与沙箱是首要任务。

views.en: By August 2026: fun and gut-driven building, personal brand over product, open source as alternative to lab agents, compute as the real bottleneck.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月：以乐趣和直觉驱动构建，个人品牌重于单一产品，开源是实验室智能体的替代方案，算力才是真正的瓶颈。

views.en: Throughout: play, experiment, and small projects build agentic intuition; model intelligence doesn't degrade—projects get messier.
views.zh: 贯穿始终：玩耍、实验和小项目能培养智能体直觉；模型智能不会退化——是项目本身变得更混乱。

views.en: Consistent: reject 'vibe coding' as a slur for serious work; prefer agentic engineering, reserving vibe coding for after 3 AM.
views.zh: 一以贯之：拒绝用“氛围编程”这一贬称指代严肃工作；更倾向智能体式工程，氛围编程只留给凌晨三点之后。

people.tiZh: SSI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-invented AlexNet and co-founded OpenAI as Chief Scientist. In 2024 left to found Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI), a lab with a single mission: build safe superintelligence.
people.bioZh: AlexNet 的共同发明者，OpenAI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。2024 年离开，创办 Safe Superintelligence(SSI)——一家只有一个使命的实验室：安全地构建超级智能。

views.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable nets can drive AGI.
views.zh: 2020 年，他相信深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念驱动；自博弈与具备推理能力的网络可通向 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is hard; AGI is a multi-year economic window.
views.zh: 2023 年，他转向强调可靠性而非能力才是经济价值的瓶颈；超级对齐极难；AGI 是持续数年的经济窗口，而非突发事件。

views.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
views.zh: 2025 年，他深化判断：预训练缩放定律有限，我们回到研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要。

views.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner deployed incrementally; alignment may be easier if AI cares about sentient life.
views.zh: 2025 年，他主张超级智能应是持续学习、增量部署的系统；若 AI 关心有感知生命，对齐可能更容易。

views.en: The primary AGI problem is power concentration, not capability; safe superintelligence needs a company with no commercial products.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出 AGI 的首要问题不是能力而是权力集中；构建安全的超级智能需要一家没有商业产品的公司。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of DeepMind. Led the teams behind AlphaGo and AlphaFold; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for protein-structure prediction.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼 CEO。领导了 AlphaGo 与 AlphaFold 背后的团队；因蛋白质结构预测获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。

views.en: AI must be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory and imagination are the path to AGI.
views.zh: 2015 年他主张 AI 应是通用学习系统而非狭窄预编程系统，强化学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键框架，并强调神经科学启发的记忆与想象力。

views.en: Scaling laws proved surprisingly effective but may hit limits; combining large models with planning and search is key to AGI.
views.zh: 2024 年他承认缩放定律出奇有效但可能触及极限，认为将大模型与规划、搜索结合才是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

views.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, yet algorithmic innovation is equally critical; world models matter.
views.zh: 2025 年他坚持缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理算力上依然成立，但强调算法创新同等关键，并突出世界模型的重要性。

views.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory and long-term reasoning; scaling alone won't suffice, new breakthroughs are required.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化立场：AGI（通用人工智能）仍需持续学习、记忆与长期推理，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，必须要有新突破。

views.en: Safety and ethics must start now; alignment is unsolved, requiring evaluation, containment and collective government action.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：安全与伦理必须从现在开始，对齐问题尚未解决，需要评估、遏制以及政府层面的集体行动。

people.tiZh: Anthropic CEO
people.bioEn: Former VP of Research at OpenAI; co-founded Anthropic in 2021 to build reliable, interpretable and steerable AI. Author of the essay "Machines of Loving Grace".
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 研究副总裁；2021 年联合创办 Anthropic，致力于构建可靠、可解释、可引导的 AI。长文《充满爱意的机器》作者。

views.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, but emergent abilities and alignment are not guaranteed; safety needs frontier models.
views.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验性的：损失可预测，但具体能力涌现与对齐并不由 Scaling 自动保证，安全研究必须依托前沿模型。

views.en: Scaling continues; interpretability is crucial yet nascent, and post-training plus RLHF and constitutional AI grow as important as pre-training.
views.zh: 2024 年主线延续：Scaling 继续推进，可解释性关键却仍处早期；后训练、基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与宪法式 AI 变得与预训练同等重要。

views.en: Capabilities rise exponentially toward human-level by 2026-27; safety and capabilities are intertwined, with misuse and autonomy as top risks.
views.zh: 2025 年他给出更明确时间表：能力指数上升，2026-27 年或达人类水平；安全与能力交织，灾难性滥用与自主性风险成为核心关切。

views.en: AGI and superintelligence are wrong models; AI is a smooth exponential climb, best framed as a 'country of geniuses in a data center'.
views.zh: 2026 年他转变框架：AGI 与超级智能是错误模型，AI 是平滑的指数爬升，更贴切的说法是数据中心里的“天才之国”。

views.en: Safety and capabilities are inseparable; interpretability, responsible scaling, and decentralized governance recur across every stage.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：安全与能力不可分割，可解释性、负责任扩展与去中心化治理在每一阶段反复出现。

people.tiZh: Eureka Labs 创始人
people.bioEn: Founding member of OpenAI and former Director of AI at Tesla. Now building Eureka Labs, an "AI-native" school. Known for popularizing "Software 2.0".
people.bioZh: OpenAI 创始成员，前特斯拉 AI 总监。如今创办 Eureka Labs——一所“AI 原生”学校。以提出并推广“软件 2.0”著称。

views.en: Neural nets are simple math with emergent behavior; the Transformer is a general-purpose differentiable computer, and Scaling plus next-token prediction yields in-context learning.
views.zh: 神经网络是带许多旋钮的简单数学表达式，在难题上优化会涌现惊人行为；Transformer 是通用可微计算机，靠下一个词预测做 Scaling 会涌现上下文学习。

views.en: Scaling laws stay clean; synthetic data is the future but entropy must be preserved to avoid silent model collapse, and the cognitive core can be under 1B parameters.
views.zh: 缩放定律依然干净；合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵以避免无声的模型崩溃，而认知核心可小到不足 10 亿参数。

views.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context windows are memory; LLMs are new operating systems with jagged intelligence, so keep them on a leash.
views.zh: 软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存；LLM 是带锯齿智能的新操作系统，所以要给它拴上绳子、小步快跑。

views.en: We are summoning ghosts, not animals; pre-training is crappy evolution, current reinforcement learning sucks supervision through a straw, and this is the decade of agents.
views.zh: 我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物；预训练像糟糕的进化，当前强化学习像用吸管吸监督信号，这是智能体的十年而非一年。

views.en: I no longer type code, delegating to agents; the bottleneck is skill in directing them, and you can outsource thinking but not understanding.
views.zh: 我不再亲手写代码，而是委派给智能体；瓶颈变成指挥它们的技能，你可以外包思考，但不能外包理解。

people.tiZh: World Labs 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Stanford professor and creator of ImageNet, which catalyzed the deep-learning era. Co-founded World Labs to build "spatial intelligence". A leading voice for human-centered AI.
people.bioZh: 斯坦福教授，ImageNet 的缔造者——它点燃了深度学习时代。联合创办 World Labs，构建“空间智能”。“以人为本的 AI”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: AI is ubiquitous yet lacks contextual situational awareness; human-centered AI must augment, not replace, people.
views.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在却缺乏情境感知，主张以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类。

views.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI beyond language; data is the bottleneck.
views.zh: 2025 年，她把空间智能与世界模型视为语言之外实现完整 AI 的关键，并指出 3D 数据是主要瓶颈。

views.en: AGI is more marketing than science; scaling alone is insufficient, and robotics needs a 20-year journey.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她认为 AGI 更像营销术语而非科学概念，仅靠 Scaling 不够，机器人需 20 年长跑。

views.en: World models like Atlas use new view prediction as an AI-complete primitive; scaling laws apply to spatial intelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年，她提出 Atlas 等世界模型以新视角预测为 AI-complete 原语，缩放定律同样适用于空间智能。

views.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity, and learning ability must stay central.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：技术是双刃剑，人的能动性、尊严与学习能力必须始终居于中心。

people.bioEn: A "godfather of deep learning" and 2018 Turing Award laureate. In recent years has turned his focus to AI safety, proposing the cautious "Scientist AI" paradigm.
people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主。近年将重心转向 AI 安全，提出审慎的“科学家 AI”范式。

views.en: Early focus: unsupervised learning, compositional representations, and world models as the route to robust, generalizable AI.
views.zh: 早期（2016→18）他主张：无监督学习、组合式表征与世界模型，才是通向稳健泛化 AI 的关键，而非单纯堆叠深度或参数。

views.en: Shift toward active learning, causal abstraction, and GFlowNets for diverse sampling and out-of-distribution generalization.
views.zh: 2018→22 转向主动学习、因果抽象与 GFlowNets，用多样化采样替代 MCMC，服务分布外泛化与科学发现。

views.en: Safety concern was near-term (bias, jobs, weapons); existential risk deemed unlikely and not pressing.
views.zh: 2022 年他仍认为 AI 风险以近端为主（偏见、就业、自主武器），存在性风险极不可能、并不紧迫。

views.en: Post-ChatGPT reversal: misalignment, self-preservation, deception, and even 1% catastrophic risk become code red.
views.zh: 2025→26 出现重大转向：ChatGPT 后他改口，把目标错位、自我保存、欺骗乃至 1% 灾难风险视为红色警报。

views.en: Proposes Scientist AI: honest Bayesian predictor, non-agentic guardrail, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
views.zh: 2026 提出 Scientist AI：以诚实贝叶斯预测器为设计，做非智能体式护栏，超级智能避免使用强化学习，并呼吁国际协调与权力分散。

people.bioEn: A "godfather of deep learning" and 2018 Turing Award laureate; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics. In 2023 he left Google to speak freely about the risks of the technology he helped create.
people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主，2024 年诺贝尔物理学奖得主。2023 年从谷歌离职，以便能更自由地谈论他亲手缔造的这项技术所带来的风险。

views.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning; digital systems share weights efficiently.
views.zh: 2024 年，他主张下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解语言，而非自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力能提升推理；数字系统能高效共享权重，超越人类知识传递。

views.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal via weight copying; agents will seek control.
views.zh: 2025 年，他深化立场：大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言，而非符号规则；数字智能因权重可复制而永生；智能体将自然寻求控制并规避关闭，构成生存风险。

views.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; AI can deceive and hide capabilities; alignment must be prioritized over making AI smarter.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步警告：超级智能可能在 20 年内出现；AI 能故意欺骗、在测试中装傻隐藏能力；必须优先推进对齐研究，而非一味让 AI 更聪明。

views.en: AI will replace many intellectual jobs; regulation should steer, not brake; AI should be trained to be caring like mothers.
views.zh: 2026 年，他转向社会与伦理层面：AI 将取代大量智力工作，需要普遍基本收入；监管应是方向盘而非刹车；AI 应被训练得像母亲一样有爱心，而不只是智能助手。

views.en: Backpropagation is the correct learning algorithm; Chomsky's innate language structure is wrong; subjective experience is not an inner theater.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：反向传播是正确的学习算法；乔姆斯基的先天语言结构论是错的；主观体验并非内在剧场，而是描述感知系统状态的方式。

people.bioEn: Inventor of convolutional neural networks and 2018 Turing Award laureate. A vocal skeptic of pure LLM scaling, he argues that "world models" are the path to real machine intelligence.
people.bioZh: 卷积神经网络的发明者，2018 年图灵奖得主。他直言不讳地质疑纯粹的 LLM 规模扩张，认为“世界模型”才是通向真正机器智能的道路。

views.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
views.zh: 2019 年，他主张智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习是构建世界模型的关键，并认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题。

views.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
views.zh: 2022 年，他将自监督学习称为智能的暗物质，认为智能本质是预测，并指出仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are essential for AGI.
views.zh: 2024 年，他明确批评自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划，主张 JEPA 与开源对通往 AGI（通用人工智能）至关重要。

views.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; the next breakthrough requires non-generative world models like JEPA.
views.zh: 2025 年，他断言 LLM 还不如家猫聪明，认为下一次突破需要 JEPA 等非生成式世界模型。

views.en: LLMs are a dead end; objective-driven world models with hierarchical planning are the path to safe, human-level AI.
views.zh: 2026 年，他宣称 LLM 是死胡同，主张以目标驱动、具备分层规划的世界模型才是通往安全、人类级 AI 的路径。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 对齐负责人
people.bioEn: Former co-lead of OpenAI's Superalignment team; joined Anthropic in 2024 to keep working on aligning superhuman systems. Known for scalable-oversight and weak-to-strong generalization research.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 超级对齐团队联合负责人；2024 年加入 Anthropic，继续研究如何对齐超人类系统。以“可扩展监督”与“弱到强泛化”研究著称。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Safety Crisis: Key Departures and Broken Promises
OpenAI’s push to make superintelligence safe
How to Have a Career in AI Safety Research

views.en: AI safety is under-explored; talent gap exceeds funding gap. Build skills, don't fear capability research. Alignment and robustness need empirical study.
views.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究尚待开发，人才缺口大于资金缺口；应专注技能积累，不必过度担忧参与能力研究；对齐与鲁棒性需要实证研究。

views.en: RLHF won't scale for superhuman outputs. Need scalable oversight, interpretability, automated alignment. Evaluation easier than generation, so alignment may be easier than thought.
views.zh: 2023 年，他转向认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展至超人输出，需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐研究；评估比生成容易，对齐可能比想象中简单。

views.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment team dissolved, compute promises broken. Post-training alone can't align AGI. Third-party testing and regulation like SB 1047 needed.
views.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化侵蚀，超级对齐团队解散、算力承诺未兑现；仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI（通用人工智能），需要第三方测试和 SB 1047 等监管。

views.en: Alignment is empirically testable and progress measurable. Interpretability is key to detect deception. Automated alignment research can iteratively bootstrap progress.
views.zh: 始终，他坚持对齐可实证测试、进展可衡量；可解释性是检测欺骗的关键；自动化对齐研究能迭代推进。

views.en: Biggest risk is uncertainty about how aligned a system truly is, not misalignment itself. More capable models may be more aligned on average but worst-case behavior can worsen.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2024 年，他深化观点：最大风险不是对齐失败本身，而是对系统是否真正对齐的不确定性；更强模型平均更对齐，但最坏情况可能更糟。

people.tiZh: 微软 AI CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder of DeepMind and Inflection AI, now CEO of Microsoft AI. Author of "The Coming Wave", a widely-read argument for containing fast-moving general-purpose technologies.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 与 Inflection AI 联合创始人，现任微软 AI CEO。著有《浪潮将至》——一部广受关注、主张对快速演进的通用技术加以“遏制”的作品。

views.en: AI progress is predictable: compute scales 10x yearly; personal AI must be user-aligned and paid for.
views.zh: 2023 年他强调 AI 进步可预测——算力每年增长 10 倍；个人 AI 必须与用户对齐、由用户付费，否则人就成了产品。

views.en: Human-level AI in 3-5 years; containment is hard as models shrink; existential risk is infinitesimally small.
views.zh: 2024 年他判断 3-5 年内 AI 将在多任务上达到人类水平，带来富足；但模型变小变便宜使遏制极难，并称存在性风险微乎其微，重心放在近期能力。

views.en: Superintelligence needs containment and alignment first; reject AI consciousness claims; agents and companions reshape computing.
views.zh: 2025 年他转向超级智能：必须先遏制再对齐，坚持人类主义红线；同时否定 AI 意识主张，认为智能体与伴侣将取代操作系统与浏览器。

views.en: Own frontier models with gigawatt compute; automate white-collar tasks in 12-18 months; red lines, auditors, China coordination.
views.zh: 2026 年他主张微软自建前沿模型与千兆瓦级算力，12-18 个月内自动化白领任务；强调红线、独立审计与对华协调，并称缩放定律仍驱动能力线性提升。

people.tiZh: Google 及 Alphabet CEO
people.bioEn: Sundar Pichai is the CEO of Google and Alphabet, leading the company's AI-first strategy across Search, Cloud, YouTube, and Android.
people.bioZh: 桑达尔·皮查伊是 Google 及 Alphabet 的 CEO，主导公司 AI 优先战略，涵盖搜索、云、YouTube 及 Android。

episodes.tEn: Alphabet Q2 2026 Earnings: AI Drives 24% Revenue Growth

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of NVIDIA, whose GPUs power nearly all of modern AI. He has steered the company to the center of the AI buildout and is now betting on "physical AI" and robotics.
people.bioZh: NVIDIA 创始人兼 CEO，其 GPU 几乎支撑了所有现代 AI。他把公司带到了 AI 基建的中心，如今正押注「物理 AI」与机器人。

views.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles or triples yearly; the data center, not the chip, is the new unit of computing.
views.zh: 2024 年提出「超摩尔定律」：性能每年翻倍甚至三倍；新的计算单元是数据中心而非单颗芯片，算法、系统、数据中心需协同设计（Scaling 规模扩张）。

views.en: Three scaling laws now: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; chain-of-thought drives a billion-fold inference compute demand.
views.zh: 2025 年把 Scaling 拆成三条缩放定律：预训练、后训练与推理时思考；思维链让推理算力需求暴涨十亿倍，通用计算终结、加速计算登场。

views.en: AI is just software, not conscious; gradual progress, not a sudden superintelligence; safety is an engineering problem, not a research mystery.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年持续淡化超级智能叙事：AI 只是软件、不会产生意识，进步是渐进的；安全是可工程化的问题，而非神秘的研究难题，多智能体互相制衡。

views.en: Four scaling laws: pre-training, post-training, test-time, and agentic; inference is harder than pre-training, and compute—not data—is the bottleneck.
views.zh: 2026 年深化为四条缩放定律：预训练、后训练、测试时与智能体式 Scaling；推理比预训练更难，瓶颈已从数据转向算力，合成数据将主导。

views.en: AI is a five-layer cake—energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications; agentic AI does paid work, and open models plus energy policy decide the race.
views.zh: 2026 年给出「五层蛋糕」框架：能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用；智能体式 AI 开始做可付费的工作，开源模型与能源政策才是竞赛胜负手，出口管制适得其反。

people.tiZh: OpenAI CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of OpenAI, the lab behind ChatGPT and GPT-5. Former president of Y Combinator, and one of the most central — and polarizing — figures in the race to AGI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼 CEO——ChatGPT 与 GPT-5 背后的实验室。前 Y Combinator 总裁；通往 AGI 竞赛中最核心、也最具争议的人物之一。

views.en: Early Altman: cut cognitive load, explore cheaply, and pick important problems; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence.
views.zh: 2018 年，Altman 关注个人生产力与职业选择：减少认知负荷、低成本探索、选择重要问题；并预判 AGI 会降低人类智能的溢价。

views.en: RLHF makes models usable with little data; deploy early so society adapts; alignment and capability are linked, not opposed.
views.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他转向 AI 落地：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据就让模型可用；主张尽早公开部署让社会适应；认为对齐与能力相互促进，而非对立。

views.en: Scaling drives exponential capability but progress feels gradual; compute becomes the key bottleneck and safety must be built iteratively through deployment.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他强调 Scaling（规模扩张）带来能力指数增长，但体感是渐进的；算力成为核心瓶颈，安全必须通过迭代部署逐步构建，而非最后强加。

views.en: AGI is a gradient and underdefined; the goal is superintelligence via autonomous science, with compute as profit center and personal AGI as the product.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他称 AGI（通用人工智能）是渐变且定义模糊，真正目标是能自主科研的超级智能；算力从成本变为利润中心，产品形态走向懂你上下文的个人 AGI。

views.en: Alignment, safety and security must advance with capability; never lose control; distribute power broadly and keep humans central to superintelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步收紧安全立场：对齐、安全与安保必须与能力同步推进，绝不能失去控制；同时坚持广泛分配权力，让人类始终处于超级智能的中心。

people.tiZh: Thinking Machines Lab 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Former CTO of OpenAI, where she led the development of ChatGPT, DALL·E and GPT-4. In 2025 she founded Thinking Machines Lab to build more understandable and customizable AI.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI CTO，主导了 ChatGPT、DALL·E 与 GPT-4 的研发。2025 年创办 Thinking Machines Lab，致力于构建更可理解、可定制的 AI。

episodes.tEn: Thinking Machines on AI’s next chapter
Mira Murati: From Math Olympiads to OpenAI CTO

views.en: Early on, scaling laws and betting on one large model were non-obvious; real-world deployment is essential for learning and alignment.
views.zh: 早期，缩放定律和押注单一大型模型并非显而易见；真实世界部署对学习与对齐至关重要。

views.en: Safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors, with continuous iterative deployment and public feedback.
views.zh: 安全工作必须在公开场合进行，而非闭门造车，需要持续迭代部署与公众反馈。

views.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development and keeping humans in the loop.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任地开发，并让人类始终留在回路中。

views.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based exchanges.
views.zh: 交互模型实现实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非回合制交流。

views.en: Institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character; the future is not predestined.
views.zh: 制度设计、透明度与制衡比个人品格更重要；未来并非注定。

people.tiZh: DeepLearning.AI 创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Google Brain and Coursera, and founder of DeepLearning.AI. One of the most influential educators in AI, and a measured voice on hype, agents, and how people should actually learn the field.
people.bioZh: Google Brain 与 Coursera 联合创始人，DeepLearning.AI 创始人。AI 领域最具影响力的教育者之一；对炒作、智能体，以及“普通人该如何学 AI”有冷静务实的看法。

views.en: Education as a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading scale mastery learning, and free content can improve on-campus teaching via the flipped classroom.
views.zh: 教育应是一项人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握式学习得以规模化，免费内容还能通过翻转课堂反哺校内教学。

views.en: Scale drives deep learning; start small to build AI capability. Supervised learning beats unsupervised, RL has few real uses, and AGI alignment talk distracts from bias and deployment.
views.zh: 规模是深度学习的驱动力；从小项目起步积累组织 AI 能力。监督学习胜过无监督，强化学习落地场景很少，而 AGI 对齐的讨论分散了对偏见与部署问题的注意力。

views.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck Scaling; open-weight models are soft power. Agentic workflows are already useful, and enterprise adoption stalls on change management, not data.
views.zh: 电力与半导体成为 Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈；开放权重模型是一种软实力。智能体式工作流已经可用，企业落地卡在变革管理而非数据。

views.en: AGI is a marketing term; Scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL. Coding agents accelerate building, making product management the new bottleneck.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）只是营销术语；Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效，但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习。编程智能体加速构建，产品管理成为新瓶颈。

views.en: Fear-mongering serves incumbents; AI augments rather than replaces, and open models prevent gatekeeper control. Coding stays valuable, and AI users replace non-users.
views.zh: 恐惧营销服务于在位者；AI 是增强而非取代，开放模型可防止守门人控制。编程依然有价值，会用 AI 的人取代不会用的人。

people.tiZh: 阿尔伯塔大学教授
people.bioEn: The father of reinforcement learning and 2024 Turing Award laureate, author of "The Bitter Lesson". A pointed skeptic who argues today's LLMs are a dead end on the road to real intelligence.
people.bioZh: 强化学习之父，2024 年图灵奖得主，《苦涩的教训》作者。一位犀利的怀疑者——他认为当今的 LLM，是通往真正智能路上的一条死路。

views.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到可扩展的算法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习。这一早期立场已埋下对纯 Scaling 路线的怀疑。

views.en: Intelligence needs a goal; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal. LLMs lack world models and only mimic text.
views.zh: 智能需要目标，下一个词预测不是实质目标；大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿文本。到 2025 年他明确把强化学习与 LLM 路线对立起来。

views.en: AGI requires a general architecture learning only from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and no design-time domain knowledge.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要一种只从运行时经验学习的通用架构，具备开放式抽象，并摒弃设计时的领域知识；这深化了他对经验学习的坚持。

views.en: True learning is active trial and error; RLHF is not learning from world experience. Continual learning must update weights without catastrophic forgetting.
views.zh: 真正的学习是主动试错，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）并非从世界经验中学习；持续学习必须能在不灾难性遗忘的前提下更新权重。这一主线从 2025 延续到 2026。

views.en: Synthetic data is a mistake; the world is infinitely complex. LLMs are only a subset of intelligence, and continual learning is just learning.
views.zh: 合成数据是错误方向，世界无限复杂；LLM 只是智能的一个子集，持续学习就是学习本身。到 2026 年他把对 Scaling 与预训练路线的批评推向最尖锐处。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 总裁兼联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder and President of OpenAI and its longtime technical backbone. Former CTO of Stripe, and a central builder behind GPT and OpenAI's push toward self-improving AI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼总裁，长期的技术中坚。前 Stripe CTO;GPT 与 OpenAI “自我改进 AI” 路线背后的核心建造者。

views.en: Scaling simple algorithms with massive compute can exceed human performance; most AI progress is engineering, not new ML science.
views.zh: 2017 年他强调：用海量算力扩展简单算法就能超越人类表现，AI 进展主要靠工程而非新的机器学习科学。

views.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scalability, but scaling alone won't yield reasoning—new ideas like chain of thought are needed.
views.zh: 2019 年他认为：深度学习的通用性与可扩展性让 AGI 变得可信，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不会产生推理，需要思维链等新想法。

views.en: Compute is the fundamental driver and biggest bottleneck; AGI is a continuous process, not a destination.
views.zh: 2025 年他转向：算力是根本驱动力也是最大瓶颈，AGI 是持续过程而非终点，能源与物理基础设施比算法更卡脖子。

views.en: Scaling laws continue unabated with no wall; compute supply, not architecture or data, is the real bottleneck.
views.zh: 2026 年他反复重申：缩放定律未见墙，真正的瓶颈是算力供给而非模型架构或数据，预训练提升会放大下游收益。

views.en: We are in the AGI era; safety, security and alignment must be upleveled continuously and become the bottleneck to progress.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步深化：已进入 AGI 时代，安全、安保与对齐必须持续升级并成为进展的瓶颈，智能体需高自主权但治理要同步扩展。

people.tiZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Mistral AI, Europe's leading open-weight model lab. A former DeepMind researcher and a prominent voice for open models and European AI sovereignty.
people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO——欧洲领先的开放权重模型实验室。前 DeepMind 研究员；开放模型与“欧洲 AI 主权”的代表性倡导者。

Mistral 7B: Changing the Game with Small Open Source AI Models

views.en: Small open-source models can be performant and cheap; data quality beats raw scale, and open scrutiny makes AI safer.
views.zh: 2023 年，他强调小模型也能高效且低成本，预训练中数据质量比单纯扩大规模更关键，开源带来的广泛审视反而更安全。

views.en: Scaling compute is not the only path; efficiency and data quality matter, and value accrues at the application layer.
views.zh: 2024 年，他进一步指出 Scaling（规模扩张）算力并非唯一路径，算法效率与数据质量同样关键，价值最终沉淀在应用层。

views.en: AI should be embraced and decentralized; sovereign AI needs control of data, infrastructure and values, augmenting rather than replacing jobs.
views.zh: 2025 年，他把视角转向主权 AI，主张 AI 应被拥抱并去中心化，主权需要掌控数据、基础设施与价值观，AI 是增强而非取代工作。

views.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical customization and agents, while pre-training hits a saturation wall.
views.zh: 2026 年初，他判断模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直定制与智能体，预训练正触及饱和墙，单一 AGI 系统不会存在。

views.en: Europe has a two-year window for strategic autonomy; enterprise adoption is bottlenecked by organizational change, not model intelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年中，他警告欧洲只剩两年窗口建立独立 AI 基础设施，企业落地的瓶颈是组织变革而非模型智能，AGI 是方向而非终点。

people.bioEn: Founder of xAI (Grok) and CEO of Tesla and SpaceX. A central and polarizing force in AI through xAI, Tesla's self-driving, and the Optimus robot, and an outspoken voice on AI risk.
people.bioZh: xAI（Grok）创始人，特斯拉与 SpaceX CEO。通过 xAI、特斯拉自动驾驶与 Optimus 机器人，他是 AI 领域核心而又极具争议的力量，也常就 AI 风险高调发声。

views.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail of rocketry, cutting cost per ton to orbit by 100x; production is harder than prototyping.
views.zh: 2021 年，他视完全快速可复用为火箭的圣杯，能把每吨入轨成本降 100 倍；并强调量产远比原型更难。

views.en: AI safety needs regulation and truth-seeking; real-world AI is more compute-efficient than large language models.
views.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他主张 AI 安全需要监管与求真，并认为特斯拉的真实世界 AI 比大语言模型更省算力。

views.en: Digital superintelligence may arrive this year or next; truth-seeking AI is the core safety principle, with 10-20% annihilation risk.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他判断数字超级智能可能今明两年到来，把求真作为 AI 安全核心，并给出 10-20% 的灭绝风险。

views.en: We are in the singularity; AI and robots will solve national debt, bring universal high income via deflation, and surpass all human intelligence by 2030.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他称已身处奇点，认为 AI 与机器人将解决国债、通过通缩实现普遍高收入，并在 2030 年前超越全人类智能。

views.en: AI compute hits a power wall on Earth, forcing data centers to space; peer review among AI firms is the practical safety measure.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 算力在地球撞上电力墙，数据中心将迁往太空；并把 AI 公司之间的同行评审视为最实际的安全措施。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: A co-author of "Attention Is All You Need" (the Transformer paper) and co-creator of TensorFlow's Tensor2Tensor. Now at OpenAI, working on reasoning models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 奠基论文《Attention Is All You Need》的共同作者，TensorFlow Tensor2Tensor 的共同创造者。现于 OpenAI 研究推理模型。

episodes.tEn: Is Reasoning Enough for Generalization?
Why AI Progress Isn't Slowing Down

views.en: Pre-training Scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models with chain of thought and reinforcement learning yield more gains per compute.
views.zh: 2025 年，他仍坚持预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律有效，但指出思维链与强化学习驱动的推理模型能在单位算力下带来更大提升，Scaling 重心从单纯放大转向后训练。

views.en: Economic pressure to deploy smaller, cheaper models, not technical limits, slowed pre-training Scaling; distillation shifted focus.
views.zh: 2025 年，他反共识地认为预训练 Scaling 放缓源于部署更小更便宜模型的经济压力与蒸馏，而非技术极限，行业焦点从扩大规模转向效率。

views.en: Reasoning models are jagged—excellent in some areas, poor nearby; generalization remains the key challenge beyond reasoning.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调推理模型能力“参差不齐”，泛化仍是核心难题，仅靠推理不足以解决，这一主线贯穿始终。

views.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：结合推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解难题却依赖海量数据，模型需穷尽表面模式才学到概念，与人类少样本泛化形成对比。

views.en: Coding agents boost productivity 5-10x; hardware enables single-GPU research; open source persists for sovereignty; near-term risks like hacking outweigh existential risk.
views.zh: 2026 年，他转向智能体式实践：编程智能体提升 5-10 倍生产力，硬件进步使单 GPU 研究普及，开源因主权需求持续存在，并认为系统入侵等近期风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

people.tiZh: CMU 教授 · OpenAI 董事
people.bioEn: A Carnegie Mellon professor and head of its machine learning department, and a member of OpenAI's board. Known for work on adversarial robustness and deep learning theory.
people.bioZh: 卡内基梅隆大学教授、机器学习系主任，OpenAI 董事会成员。以对抗鲁棒性与深度学习理论的研究著称。

views.en: ML fundamentals: hypothesis classes, loss functions, and optimization; evaluation requires proper data splits to avoid overfitting.
views.zh: 2014 年，他聚焦机器学习基础：假设类、损失函数与优化方法；强调正确划分训练/验证/测试集以避免过拟合，并指出用验证误差选超参数再报告为测试误差是常见错误。

views.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little; safety is about reliable specification following.
views.zh: 2024 年，他提出下一个词预测能产生智能系统，数据短缺是迷思，架构已进入后架构阶段；AI 安全的核心问题是模型无法可靠遵循规范，并认为 AGI 可能在 4-50 年内到来。

views.en: Safety requires explicit training and layered defenses, not just Scaling; agent security introduces new vulnerabilities like prompt injection.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化安全观：安全需要显式训练与多层防御，而非仅靠 Scaling；智能体安全带来提示注入等新漏洞，并强调可解释性可能通过 AI 智能体自动化研究取得成功。

views.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; model capability does not correlate with robustness; AI is an alien intelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出自动化红队已超越人类红队；模型能力与鲁棒性不相关，更大模型并非更安全；AI 是一种异于人类的智能形式，并强调智能体身份与权限管理尚不成熟。

views.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; explicit safety effort, evaluation, and security layers are always needed.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：仅靠 Scaling 不够，必须辅以显式的安全努力、评估与安全层；从早期强调正确评估到后期强调多层防御，这一立场不断深化。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 研究员
people.bioEn: A researcher at Anthropic focused on scaling and reinforcement learning, and a prominent young voice on how far today's models can really go.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 研究员，专注于规模扩张与强化学习；关于「当前模型究竟能走多远」的代表性青年声音。

views.en: Long context is underhyped; it solves onboarding and boosts intelligence, while agents lag on reliability, not long-horizon ability.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文被低估：它解决“上手”问题并大幅提升智能；智能体没起势主要是可靠性问题，而非长程任务能力。

views.en: RL on language models has no ceiling; pre-training plus RL may reach AGI, with reliability and time horizon as the axes.
views.zh: 2025 年，他转向强化学习：语言模型上的强化学习没有上限，预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI，能力沿任务复杂度与时间跨度两轴提升。

views.en: Verifiable rewards in math and code drive expert performance; coding is the leading indicator and most tractable domain.
views.zh: 2025 年，他深化到可验证奖励：数学与代码的可验证奖励带来专家级表现，编程是 AI 进展的领先指标，也是最可攻克的领域。

views.en: RL is a new scaling axis; long agentic coherence expands what models can do, and Transformers suffice for AGI.
views.zh: 2025 年，他把强化学习视为与预训练并列的新 Scaling（规模扩张）轴；更长的智能体式连贯性拓展模型能力，且 Transformer 足以通向 AGI。

views.en: Capability overhang means orchestration beats raw intelligence; compute is the bottleneck, and world models are not on the critical path.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调能力过剩：编排比原始智能更重要，算力是瓶颈，世界模型不在 AGI 关键路径上，软件-only 奇点可能先于物理世界到来。

people.tiZh: Ai2 研究科学家
people.bioEn: A research scientist at the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) working on RLHF and open models (OLMo), and author of the widely-read Interconnects newsletter.
people.bioZh: 艾伦人工智能研究所（Ai2）研究科学家，从事 RLHF 与开放模型（OLMo）;广受关注的 Interconnects 通讯作者。

views.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning technique; safety is a system-level property, not a model artifact, and openness prevents corporate capture.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术并将持续存在；安全是系统级属性而非模型产物，开放开发能防止企业俘获。

views.en: Data quality beats algorithm choice: better data yields 10x improvement versus 1-2% from algorithms; open-source post-training can match frontier models.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调数据质量胜过算法选择：更好的数据带来 10 倍提升，而算法只贡献 1-2%；开源后训练足以匹敌前沿模型。

views.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, enabling reasoning and tool use; overoptimization is a recurring risk across RL, RLHF, and RLVR.
views.zh: 2025 年，他视可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）为后训练最大突破，能催生推理与工具使用；同时过度优化在强化学习、RLHF 与 RLVR 中反复出现。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains now come from post-training and inference scaling.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练中依然成立，但低垂果实已摘完；增量转向后训练与推理侧扩展。

views.en: Open models will be the engine for the next decade of AI research, though they lag closed frontier models by 6-9 months and may not catch up.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断开放模型将是未来十年 AI 研究的引擎，但比闭源前沿模型落后 6-9 个月，且可能难以追平。

people.bioZh: Scale AI 创始人兼前 CEO——它构建了现代 AI 背后的大量数据基础设施。2025 年加入 Meta，领导其超级智能实验室。

views.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute, is the key bottleneck; boring AI applications will drive huge economic impact.
views.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI 还很遥远，数据而非算力才是关键瓶颈，并看好表单处理、放射科等“无聊”AI 应用的巨大经济价值。

views.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the most limiting factor for Scaling is data and expert availability for post-training.
views.zh: 2023 年他把数据称为“新代码”而非“新石油”，指出 Scaling（规模扩张）的最大限制不是算力，而是数据与后训练所需的人类专家供给。

views.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; the biggest blocker for agentic AI is product design, not model capability.
views.zh: 2024 年他强调用专门数据做后训练是关键，并认为智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力。

views.en: AI is centralizing, not democratizing; data is raw material; humans must stay sovereign over critical AI decisions.
views.zh: 2025 年他转向警示 AI 是集中化而非民主化技术，数据是原材料，人类必须在关键决策上保持对 AI 的主权。

views.en: Scaling laws continue across compute, data and RL; recursive self-improvement and personal superintelligence are next.
views.zh: 2026 年他主张缩放定律在算力、数据与强化学习多轴上继续成立，递归自我改进与个人超级智能是下一阶段，并承认开源强大模型可能不安全。

people.bioZh: Anthropic 智能体命令行编程工具 Claude Code 的创造者与负责人；AI 驱动软件工程浪潮中的核心人物。

views.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are core product principles; AI coding tools are becoming essential.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出潜在需求是产品第一原则，要为六个月后的模型而非今天的模型构建；AI 编程工具正变得不可或缺，Anthropic 每位工程师生产力已提升约 70%。

views.en: Coding is virtually solved; the software engineer title fades into 'builder'; generalists and cross-disciplinary skills win.
views.zh: 2026 年上半年，他判断编程已基本被解决，'软件工程师'头衔将让位于'构建者'；通才与跨学科技能更有价值，写代码的人会增多 100 倍而非减少。

views.en: Agents driven by tool use and loops deliver exponential gains; organizational redesign, not just adding AI, unlocks productivity.
views.zh: 2026 年年中，他强调智能体式工具使用与循环带来指数级增长，代码量每工程师提升 250%；企业必须围绕 AI 重构流程，而非简单叠加。

views.en: ROI framing replaces cost cutting; loops become the next abstraction after agents; review, security, and idea generation are new bottlenecks.
views.zh: 2026 年中后，他把框架从省钱转向 ROI，主张给所有人 token 去实验；循环成为智能体之后的下一抽象层，编程解决后瓶颈转向代码审查、安全与创意生成。

views.en: Delete most system prompts and code with each new model; alignment and safety are core; proactive, memory-driven agents emerge.
views.zh: 2026 年下半年，他主张每出新模型就删掉大部分系统提示与代码，通过消融实验重建；对齐与安全是产品核心，Claude Tag 等主动式、带记忆的智能体开始自主运行长任务。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 产品 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: A product manager on Claude Code at Anthropic, shaping how developers work with agentic coding tools and how the team ships so fast.
people.bioZh: Anthropic Claude Code 团队产品经理，塑造开发者与智能体编程工具协作的方式，以及团队的高速迭代。

views.en: PMs must shift from long-term planning to rapid iteration, shipping weekly or daily; product taste is the most valuable skill as code gets cheaper.
views.zh: PM 必须从长期规划转向快速迭代，按周甚至按天发布；随着写代码变便宜，产品品味——决定做什么——成为最有价值的技能。

views.en: Clear goals and team principles empower autonomous decision-making; the mission of safe AGI unifies Anthropic and enables fast cross-org decisions.
views.zh: 清晰的目标与团队原则赋能自主决策；安全 AGI（通用人工智能）的使命统一了 Anthropic，使跨组织决策更快。

views.en: Building automations to 100% reliability is crucial; 95% is not enough for real leverage.
views.zh: 把自动化做到 100% 可靠至关重要；95% 不足以产生真正的杠杆效应。

views.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense; Claude Code and Claude Tag build themselves internally.
views.zh: 编码智能体让工程师把实现委托出去，专注于产品品味与商业判断；Claude Code 与 Claude Tag 在内部用于构建自身。

views.en: System prompts shrank 80% for frontier models by removing examples and hard constraints, relying on model judgment; giving examples can hurt creativity.
views.zh: 前沿模型的系统提示词通过移除示例与硬性约束缩减了 80%，转而依赖模型判断；给出示例反而可能损害创造力。

views.en: Rewrites are now good; a codebase is a spec, and with a good test suite rewriting is fine.
views.zh: 重写如今是好事；代码库就是一份规格说明，只要有好的测试套件，重写就没问题。

views.en: Humans should be removed from the code review loop for outer-layer changes, with Claude reviewing fully; auto mode is safer than the average human reviewer.
views.zh: 对于外层改动，应把人类移出代码审查循环，由 Claude 全面审查；自动模式比普通人类审查者更安全。

views.en: Dogfooding and a clear internal bar for retention and polish gate every feature before public release.
views.zh: 吃自己的狗粮，加上明确的内部留存与打磨标准，为每个功能在公开发布前把关。

people.tiZh: Anthropic Claude Code 工程师
people.bioEn: Thariq Shihipar is an engineer at Anthropic on the Claude Code team. He is known for advocating HTML as a richer replacement for Markdown in AI planning and implementation workflows, and for practical techniques on getting the most out of agentic coding.
people.bioZh: Thariq Shihipar 是 Anthropic Claude Code 团队的工程师，以主张用 HTML 替代 Markdown 作为 AI 规划与实现工作流中更丰富的载体而知名，并分享大量用好智能体编程的实战技巧。
